294: 出场时，复制同伴的能力变化。
When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.

Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move

species.fl: 在出生后的一段时间内，它会吸收背上种子里储存着的营养成长。
species.fl_en: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

species.fl: 沐浴在阳光下越久，身体内会涌出越多力量，背上的花苞也会渐渐成长。
species.fl_en: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

species.fl: 花朵散发出的迷人香味能安抚激动的心情，甚至消弭斗争。
species.fl_en: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

species.fl: 生下来的时候，尾巴上就有火焰在燃烧。火焰熄灭时，它的生命也会结束。
species.fl_en: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

species.fl: 如果它在战斗中亢奋起来，就会喷出灼热的火焰，把周围的东西烧得一干二净。
species.fl_en: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

species.fl: 能用翅膀飞到距地面１４００米的高度。会吐出高温火焰。
species.fl_en: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

species.fl: 当它遇到危险的时候，会将四肢收回龟壳里保护自己，同时从嘴里喷出水来。
species.fl_en: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

species.fl: 会灵巧地摆动自己毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴，借此在水中保持平衡。
species.fl_en: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

species.fl: 从龟壳上的大炮里放出的喷射水流足以贯穿厚实的铁板。
species.fl_en: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

species.fl: 别看它的脚很短，因为是吸盘，所以无论是斜坡还是墙壁都能轻松前进。
species.fl_en: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

species.fl: 虽然有坚硬的外壳，因为壳里的身体很软，所以无法抵抗强力的攻击。
species.fl_en: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

species.fl: 每天都忙着采集花蜜。习惯往腿部的细毛上涂满花蜜，然后带回巢穴里。
species.fl_en: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

species.fl: 头上长有尖锐的针。它喜欢藏在森林或草丛里大量吞食树叶。
species.fl_en: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

species.fl: 虽然几乎动也动不了，但是如果遇到了危险，有时似乎会竖起毒刺来反抗。
species.fl_en: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

species.fl: 它会用双手和尾部的３根毒针反复刺伤敌人。
species.fl_en: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

species.fl: 性格沉着冷静，即使受到攻击也很少反击，只会朝对手扬起沙子保护自己。
species.fl_en: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

species.fl: 拥有超群的体力，而且飞翔范围广，经常飞到很远的地方寻找食物。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

species.fl: 以２马赫的飞行速度来觅食。它巨大的爪子是非常令人惧怕的武器。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

species.fl: 有两颗大门牙，见什么咬什么。只要看到１只小拉达出没，附近肯定还住着40只以上。
species.fl_en: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

species.fl: 它的后脚上长着小蹼，以便它在水中游泳寻找食物。
species.fl_en: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

species.fl: 不擅长高空飞行。会以超高速在地盘里四处盘旋，以保护自己的地盘不被侵犯。
species.fl_en: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

species.fl: 很久以前就存在的宝可梦。哪怕只察觉到一丝危险，都会立即飞向高空。
species.fl_en: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

species.fl: 身体会随着年龄增长不断变长。每到夜里，它会一圈圈地将身体缠绕在树枝上休息。
species.fl_en: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

species.fl: 根据研究证实，它腹部那可怕的纹路大约有６个种类已经得到确认。
species.fl_en: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

species.fl: 皮卡丘们把尾巴贴在一起交换电流，其实是在互相打招呼。
species.fl_en: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

species.fl: 如果电囊空了，它就会直直地竖起尾巴，收集空气中的电流。
species.fl_en: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

species.fl: 会在地上挖洞建造巢穴。挖洞时，即便遇到地里的坚硬岩石，也能用尖锐的爪子弄碎后继续挖进。
species.fl_en: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

species.fl: 会将锐利的爪子钩在树上爬树。这是为了设法使树果掉落，分给等在树下的穿山鼠们。
species.fl_en: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

species.fl: 用坚硬的门牙咬碎树果吃。和雄性相比，角的尖端稍圆一些。
species.fl_en: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.

species.fl: 如果族群遇到了危险，会和伙伴们团结起来，施展出超音波大合唱。
species.fl_en: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

species.fl: 把孩子放在背上刺与刺的空隙里来哄它们。在这时绝对不会释放毒素。
species.fl_en: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

species.fl: 身材虽小，却性格勇敢。为了保护相好的雌性，会不顾生命果敢地战斗。
species.fl_en: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

species.fl: 神经敏感，动不动就打架。体内的肾上腺素一增加，毒素的浓度也会提高。
species.fl_en: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

species.fl: 以力量为傲的宝可梦。用自己的粗尾巴和连钻石都能击碎的角，豪爽地战斗。
species.fl_en: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

species.fl: 因可爱的举止和叫声而广受欢迎的宝可梦。不过很少被人发现。
species.fl_en: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

species.fl: 听觉灵敏，连１公里以外针落地的声音都听得见，因此平时会待在安静的地方。
species.fl_en: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

species.fl: 随着身体的成长，６根尾巴的毛发也会变得更漂亮。紧紧抱着它时能感到微微的温暖。
species.fl_en: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

species.fl: 聪明伶俐，但爱记仇。据说如果敢乱抓它的尾巴，它就会缠着你作祟１０００年。
species.fl_en: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

species.fl: 能够随意改变声音的波长，唱出听了绝对会犯困的神奇旋律。
species.fl_en: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

species.fl: 以自己细腻的体毛为傲。尤其是额头上的卷毛，更是有着天堂般的极致触感。
species.fl_en: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

species.fl: 栖息在晒不到阳光的洞窟里。到了早晨便会和同伴聚集起来，一边互相取暖一边睡觉。
species.fl_en: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

species.fl: 用小而灵活的脚走路。会悄悄接近正在睡觉的猎物，用尖牙咬住对方吸取血液。
species.fl_en: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

species.fl: 白天会为躲避太阳而钻入凉爽的地下。会通过沐浴月光成长。
species.fl_en: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

species.fl: 看似口水的东西其实是甜甜的蜜。非常黏稠，只要碰到就会一直黏住。
species.fl_en: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

species.fl: 虽然花瓣越大，就能放出越多的花粉，但这样脑袋会变沉，容易疲倦。
species.fl_en: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

species.fl: 它会通过挖洞来从树根里吸取营养，但大部分营养都会被背上的蘑菇抢走。
species.fl_en: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

species.fl: 由于虫子的精华不断被吸走，在思考的似乎已经不是虫子，而是背上的蘑菇了。
species.fl_en: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

species.fl: 在明亮的地方你便能发现它具有雷达功能的大眼其实是由许多个小眼睛聚集而成的。
species.fl_en: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

species.fl: 如果不小心把它翅膀上的鳞粉沾到了身上，那不但会很难去除，更糟的是毒素也会从那里渗入。
species.fl_en: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

species.fl: 在地下较浅的地方移动。被它挖掘过的地面会鼓起来，所以非常容易发现。
species.fl_en: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

species.fl: 三胞胎的地鼠，拥有能够挖掘到地下１００公里深的潜力。没人知道它在地下的部分究竟长成什么样子。
species.fl_en: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

species.fl: 为了不弄脏额头上的金币，会常常洗脸。和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。
species.fl_en: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

species.fl: 拥有优雅高贵的身姿。与野蛮的喵头目性格不合，互相看不起对方。
species.fl_en: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

species.fl: 头痛会随着压力逐渐累积而不断加剧。会用强大的念力击垮周围的一切。
species.fl_en: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

species.fl: 古老的故事中说，它会把污染河水的人类拖进水中带走。
species.fl_en: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

species.fl: 身体轻盈，在树上生活。常因鸡毛蒜皮的小事发火而飞扑到周围的东西上。
species.fl_en: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

species.fl: 只有在谁都不在身边的时候才不生气，但几乎没有人目击过这种情况。
species.fl_en: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

species.fl: 性格忠诚。为了保护自己的训练家，会拼命地朝对手狂吠。
species.fl_en: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

species.fl: 从古时候起就是俘获了众多人心的美丽宝可梦。能像飞一样轻巧地奔跑。
species.fl_en: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

species.fl: 在水流湍急的河里，会把厚厚的嘴唇像吸盘那样紧紧吸在岩石上避免被冲走。
species.fl_en: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

species.fl: 流出的汗是黏滑的粘液状。即使被敌人捉住，也能哧溜一下滑走逃脱。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

species.fl: 除了游泳还擅长格斗技。能用经过锻炼的手臂使出豪迈强力的拳击。
species.fl_en: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

species.fl: 能够在睡梦中使出瞬间移动。据说它睡得越熟，就能移动到越遥远的地方。
species.fl_en: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

species.fl: 念力的威力大得惊人。会把精神力量储存在额头的星星里，以备进化之需。
species.fl_en: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

species.fl: 会操纵强大的超能力。据说它双手握着的汤勺就是用那力量制造出来的。
species.fl_en: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

species.fl: 时时刻刻都充满力量。由于体力过剩而去举起岩石消磨时间，也因此变得更强。
species.fl_en: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

species.fl: 有着不会疲劳的强韧肉体。会去帮助人类完成例如搬运沉重行李之类的工作。
species.fl_en: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

species.fl: ４只手臂在思考之前就会反射性地行动，使出多发拳击。
species.fl_en: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

species.fl: 喜欢温度高，有一定湿度的地方。它会用身上的藤蔓抓小虫来吃。
species.fl_en: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

species.fl: 它在肚子饿的时候会吞掉周围会动的东西，分泌溶解液让其致命。
species.fl_en: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

species.fl: 用花蜜的香味引诱猎物。据说被它吞入嘴里的东西，只要1天就会溶解到连骨头都不剩。
species.fl_en: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

species.fl: 身体的大部分由水组成。在海中，会和海水混为一体，非常难以发现。
species.fl_en: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

species.fl: ８０根触手伸缩自如。会像撒网那样伸开触手抓住猎物并刺入毒针。
species.fl_en: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

species.fl: 大多栖息于山路。由于不留神踩到它会使它大发雷霆，得多加小心。
species.fl_en: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

species.fl: 常在山路上滚来滚去。滚动时从来不关心前面的路上都有什么。
species.fl_en: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

species.fl: 刚蜕皮时浑身都白白的非常柔软，但是接触到空气之后会迅速变坚硬。
species.fl_en: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

species.fl: 得到了小火马认可的人，在触摸它燃烧着的鬃毛时不会觉得烫手，真是不可思议。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

species.fl: 奔跑速度最快的烈焰马会成为首领，决定族群前往的地点和奔跑速度。
species.fl_en: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

species.fl: 把尾巴泡在水里后会有甜味渗出，因此它会以尾巴为诱饵吸引宝可梦并将其钓起。
species.fl_en: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

species.fl: 因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝离开后，它似乎就会变回呆呆兽。
species.fl_en: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

species.fl: 靠吃电来维持生命。会一边从左右两边的组件放射电磁波一边在空中飞行。
species.fl_en: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

species.fl: 会不断释放很强的的磁力。在三合一磁怪接近时，大多数电脑都会发生异常情况。
species.fl_en: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

species.fl: 用植物的茎来战斗。茎的挥舞方式存在着好几种不同的流派。
species.fl_en: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

species.fl: 羽毛较短所以不擅长飞行，但是拥有发达的双脚，能够以很快的速度奔跑。
species.fl_en: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

species.fl: 由嘟嘟的某个头分裂出的变种。以60千米的时速在草原上奔跑。
species.fl_en: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

species.fl: 喜欢天寒地冻的地方，就算零下10度也能愉快地游泳。
species.fl_en: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 全身像雪一样白。十分耐寒，即使是在有浮冰的大海里也能很精神地游来游去。
species.fl_en: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

species.fl: 它由囤积的淤泥而形成。臭到让人无法碰触，凡是它走过的地方都寸草不生。
species.fl_en: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

species.fl: 非常难闻！气味臭到让人窒息，但由于鼻子的退化，它自己完全闻不到味道。
species.fl_en: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

species.fl: 坚硬的壳能反弹任何攻击。壳打开时，如果里面的部分受到攻击，就会变得很脆弱。
species.fl_en: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

species.fl: 一旦它把壳闭上，无论是拥有什么样怪力的人都无法将其打开。
species.fl_en: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

species.fl: 能用稀薄气体状的身体潜入任何地方，但只要起风就会被吹跑。
species.fl_en: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

species.fl: 如果黑暗中空空如也，但你却感觉被什么盯上了，那么鬼斯通一定就在那里。
species.fl_en: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

species.fl: 据说它会为了夺取山中遇难者的生命而从黑暗中出现。
species.fl_en: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

species.fl: 弯曲扭动巨大结实的身体，以时速８０公里的猛烈劲头向前挖进。
species.fl_en: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

species.fl: 如果你每晚与它一起睡觉，它偶尔会让你梦见它以前吃过的梦。
species.fl_en: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

species.fl: 无意中遇到它的时候，如果不小心和它对上视线会很危险。它手里拿着的钟摆会让人睡着。
species.fl_en: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

species.fl: 如果危险逼近，就会从嘴里吐出泡沫包裹全身，让身体看起来更大。
species.fl_en: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

species.fl: 巨大的钳子破坏力十足，但是因为太过沉重，不战斗的时候就很碍事。
species.fl_en: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

species.fl: 据说它与精灵球相似的外形其实是它的保护色，但它很容易自爆这一点也出人意料。
species.fl_en: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

species.fl: 只要受到一点撞击，就会由于体内的电能溢出导致爆炸。
species.fl_en: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

species.fl: ６只不在一起就不安心。哪怕只是少了１只，都会马上想要逃跑。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

species.fl: ３个脑袋联合起来能使出强大的精神力量。天气变阴时动作会变得迟钝。
species.fl_en: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

species.fl: 它头上戴着死去母亲的头骨。虽然也会因悲伤的梦境而哭泣，但每流一次泪，都会变得更加坚强。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

species.fl: 进化后，与原本戴在头上的母亲头骨完全融为一体，而且性格也变得十分凶暴。
species.fl_en: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

species.fl: 腿能自由地伸缩，即使离得很远，也能把对手踢飞。
species.fl_en: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

species.fl: 打出的拳击甚至能劈开空气。但攻击３分钟后，它似乎就会想休息一下。
species.fl_en: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

species.fl: 主要以虫宝可梦为食。会用长长的舌头舔对手，等对手麻痹后将其整个吞下。
species.fl_en: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

species.fl: 污浊的空气是它的美味大餐。据说在昔日的伽勒尔地区曾经存在着更多的瓦斯弹。
species.fl_en: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

species.fl: 虽然吸入空气的力量稍弱于伽勒尔的双弹瓦斯，制造出的毒素却更加强力。
species.fl_en: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

species.fl: 脑子里只能记住一件事。一旦开始猛冲，不管理由是什么都会很快感到无所谓而忘掉。
species.fl_en: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

species.fl: 全身被铠甲般的皮肤保护着。甚至能在２０００度的熔岩里生存。
species.fl_en: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

species.fl: 原本动作迟缓。为了保护蛋不被抢走，逃跑的速度才变快了。
species.fl_en: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
species.evo: 携带浑圆之石 白天

species.fl: 藤蔓有着独特的香气。在伽勒尔的部分地区被当做香草使用。
species.fl_en: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

species.fl: 据记载，曾有没孩子的袋兽将遇难人类的小孩抚养长大。
species.fl_en: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

species.fl: 会像跳舞一样在水中游动以制造漩涡。作为娱乐，会和伙伴比拼谁的漩涡更大。
species.fl_en: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

species.fl: 嘴巴虽然细，吸引力却很强。就算是比嘴巴还大的猎物，也能一瞬间吸进嘴里吃掉。
species.fl_en: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

species.fl: 背鳍和尾鳍像肌肉那样发达。能够以５节的速度在水中游泳。
species.fl_en: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

species.fl: 金鱼王之所以会用角挖穿河底的岩石来筑巢，是为了防止产下的卵被水流冲走。
species.fl_en: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

species.fl: 虽然会遭到鱼宝可梦的啄食，但身体即使被咬掉一块也能马上再生，所以完全不在意。
species.fl_en: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

species.fl: 会高速旋转着身体一边游泳一边吸收微小的浮游生物。
species.fl_en: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

species.fl: 擅长表演默剧。用手指放出的波动制造墙壁，保护自己免于大多数攻击。
species.fl_en: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

species.fl: 如果在森林中发现某个地方有大量树木被砍倒，就说明那里是飞天螳螂的领地。
species.fl_en: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

species.fl: 伽勒尔的迷唇姐外表靓丽，拥有纤细叫声的也不在少数，甚至有为其着迷的粉丝。
species.fl_en: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

species.fl: 暴风雨来临时，它们就会集结在高高的大树周围，耐心地等待落雷。
species.fl_en: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

species.fl: 全身时刻都在燃烧。大家认为它是引发火灾的原因之一，非常惧怕它。
species.fl_en: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

species.fl: 用角夹住猎物后，不是直接把对方切成两半，就是强行把对方扔飞。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

species.fl: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗性格暴躁，决不允许人类骑在自己的背上。
species.fl_en: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

species.fl: 又弱又可怜的宝可梦。在水流比较快的地方只能任凭自己被水冲走。
species.fl_en: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

species.fl: 就算是在狂风暴雨中，只要发狂的暴鲤龙出现，一切都会被它烧毁殆尽。
species.fl_en: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

species.fl: 十分耐寒，不畏冰海。皮肤滑滑的，摸上去会有点凉。
species.fl_en: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

species.fl: 当两只百变怪相遇的时候，为了能变成和对方相同的样子，它们动起来会比平常更加剧烈。
species.fl_en: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

species.fl: 由于不稳定的遗传基因，蕴含着各种各样进化可能性的特殊宝可梦。
species.fl_en: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

species.fl: 身体细胞的结构与水分子相似。它能和水融为一体，让别人无法看见它。
species.fl_en: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

species.fl: 能够吸入空气中的负离子，有时会吐出大约有１００００伏特的高压电。
species.fl_en: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

species.fl: 会将吸入的空气的一部分传送到自己体内的火囊里，制造出１７００度的火焰。
species.fl_en: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 近年来十分活跃于电脑空间。到处检查有没有可疑的数据。
species.fl_en: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

species.fl: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。依靠１０只脚来划水，在水中轻盈地游曳。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

species.fl: 拥有足以咬碎岩石的锋利牙齿，但是能够袭击的猎物仅限触手可以伸展的范围之内。
species.fl_en: Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

species.fl: 虽然存在已经灭绝的说法，但据说在一部分地区还是经常能见到它的身影。
species.fl_en: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

species.fl: 灭绝的原因尚不明确。曾经栖息在温暖的大海，是性格残暴的古代宝可梦。
species.fl_en: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

species.fl: 长着锯子般的牙齿。甚至连钢属性宝可梦的皮肤都会被它的牙齿撕成碎片。
species.fl_en: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

species.fl: 拥有一个结实的胃，即使吃了发霉腐烂的东西，也完全不会吃坏肚子。
species.fl_en: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

species.fl: 拥有能够自由操纵冰的能力。据说它栖息在永久冻土的雪山。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

species.fl: 传说的鸟宝可梦。据说只要它一摩擦翅膀，就会立刻发生落雷。
species.fl_en: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

species.fl: 相传它会用燃烧着的美丽翅膀照亮山道，救助在此遇险的人。
species.fl_en: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

species.fl: 长久以来被认为只存在于幻想之中。额头小小的突起是正在发育的角。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

species.fl: 把力量集中在尾巴的珠子上操纵天气。散发气场的样子非常神秘。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

species.fl: 被称为大海的化身。很多船都会把快龙的雕像设置在船头。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

species.fl: 超梦的基因几乎和梦幻完全一样，但是大小和性格却迥异得让人吃惊。
species.fl_en: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

species.fl: 用显微镜可以看到它身上极短极细且密集的体毛。
species.fl_en: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

species.fl: 非常喜欢沐浴阳光。会用头上的叶子来寻找温暖的地方。
species.fl_en: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

species.fl: 只要闻到从它脖子周围散发出的像香辛料一样的香味，不知为何就会想要对战。
species.fl_en: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

species.fl: 只要待在大竺葵身边，就会像享受了森林浴一样，让心情变得清新舒畅。
species.fl_en: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

species.fl: 平时会将背部蜷起。但当它发怒或受惊时，会从背部喷出火焰。
species.fl_en: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

species.fl: 战斗前会背过身去向对手展示自己的火焰有多么厉害。
species.fl_en: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

species.fl: 该宝可梦藏有大绝招。会摩擦熊熊燃烧着的体毛，掀起爆炸气浪进行攻击。
species.fl_en: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

species.fl: 因为它发达的颚充满了力量，不管是什么都能咬碎，所以就算是它的训练家也要当心。
species.fl_en: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

species.fl: 向后弯曲的牙齿尖端让它一旦叼住猎物，就绝不会松口。
species.fl_en: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

species.fl: 会用大而有力的颚咬住对手，然后就那样甩动脖子将对手撕得粉碎。
species.fl_en: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

species.fl: 警戒心很强的宝可梦。柔韧摆动的尾巴肌肉发达，摸上去很硬。
species.fl_en: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

species.fl: 在细长的巢穴中养育孩子。等孩子长大后，就会让孩子到巢穴外做独立生活的准备。
species.fl_en: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

species.fl: 总是在固定的时间鸣叫，因此也有训练家拿它来代替钟表带出门。
species.fl_en: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

species.fl: 开始思考事情时，会将脖子旋转１８０度，以此提高大脑的工作效率。
species.fl_en: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

species.fl: 非常胆小的宝可梦。会和伙伴一起张开反射壁来保护巢穴。
species.fl_en: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

species.fl: 在夜空中飞翔的同时会抛撒闪闪发光的粉末。据说粉末沾到身上就会有好事发生。
species.fl_en: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

species.fl: 牙齿上的毒并不强烈，但用来削弱那些挂在网上无法动弹的猎物是绰绰有余了。
species.fl_en: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

species.fl: 会通过吐丝来捕捉猎物。到了晚上，就会离开巢穴并积极地狩猎。
species.fl_en: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

species.fl: 可以自由地控制４根翅膀振翅而飞。即使在狭窄的洞窟内也能保持速度飞来飞去。
species.fl_en: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

species.fl: 在黑暗的海底，触手上不断闪烁着的光是它们唯一的通信手段。
species.fl_en: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

species.fl: 发出强光蒙住猎物的眼睛。抓住那一瞬间的空档，使其遭受电的攻击。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

species.fl: 脸颊上的电囊还很小，如果囊里的电太多了，就会漏出来电到自己。
species.fl_en: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

species.fl: 有着星星一样的轮廓。由于那外形，人们相信它是乘着流星而来的。
species.fl_en: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

species.fl: 用柔软的身体弹跳著移动。当它的体温上升时，身体会变成深粉红色。
species.fl_en: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

species.fl: 好运的象征。据说在它的壳里装着满满的幸福。
species.fl_en: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

species.fl: 不待在温柔的人身边就会变得没有精神。不挥动翅膀也能浮在空中。
species.fl_en: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

species.fl: 由于羽翼未丰，所以会跳着移动。一直在注视着什么。
species.fl_en: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

species.fl: 能够看穿过去和未来。日复一日注视着太阳动向的奇异宝可梦。
species.fl_en: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

species.fl: 绒毛摩擦产生的电力会被储存起来。如果觉得可爱而直接用手碰它的话，就会被啪地一下电得又麻又痛。
species.fl_en: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

species.fl: 能将电力储存在松软的毛发中。因为储存了太多电力，所以身上有些地方已经变得光秃秃的了。
species.fl_en: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

species.fl: 尾巴会发出很强的亮光。从以前起，它就被船员们当做路标而深受重视。
species.fl_en: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

species.fl: 有时能看到美丽花聚在一起做着像是跳舞一样的动作。据说这是呼唤太阳的仪式。
species.fl_en: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

species.fl: 体毛的防水性能很好，就算是从冰冷的海里上岸，身体也会立刻干掉，一点都不冷。
species.fl_en: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

species.fl: 会制作填满空气的泡泡。当露力丽在河里玩的时候，它就会用这个泡泡包住露力丽。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

species.fl: 为了不被袭击会模仿树的样子。很讨厌水，所以下雨后，不知什么时候就会消失。
species.fl_en: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

species.fl: 雄性的叫声更响亮。叫声低沉可怕的蚊香蛙皇更能受到雌性的欢迎。
species.fl_en: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带王者之证

species.fl: 会随着风移动到很远的地方。没有人知道帕底亚的毽子草具体是从哪里来的。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

species.fl: 据说热爱毽子花的人能够通过它头上花朵散发的香味猜出它在哪里出生的。
species.fl_en: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

species.fl: 会随季风到处旅行。当毽子棉的棉孢子掉光的时候，就是它的旅行和生命终结之时。
species.fl_en: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

species.fl: 会从树上寻找猎物。发现喜食的甜竹竹后，就会兴奋地飞扑过去。
species.fl_en: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

species.fl: 会在某日清晨突然掉下来。对自己的弱小心知肚明，所以直到进化为止会不断积存养分。
species.fl_en: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

species.fl: 白天总是精力充沛，随心所欲地到处活动，但太阳下山后却一动不动。
species.fl_en: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

species.fl: 会高速扇动翅膀让自身停留在空中以监视自己的地盘。
species.fl_en: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

species.fl: 为了在地面上行走时不让皮肤干燥，会用有毒的粘膜覆盖身体。
species.fl_en: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

species.fl: 身体总是滑溜溜的。虽然游泳时头总会撞到河底，但它自己毫不在意。
species.fl_en: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

species.fl: 从额头的珠子放射出精神力量进行战斗。当力量用尽时，珠子的颜色也会褪去。
species.fl_en: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

species.fl: 在满月之夜或是兴奋的时候，它身上圈圈一样的花纹就会发出金黄色的光。
species.fl_en: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

species.fl: 会为老大去寻找闪闪发光的东西。据说它很不吉利，厌恶它的人也很多。
species.fl_en: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

species.fl: 虽然无论向呆呆王提出什么难题它都会帮忙解决，但是谁都无法理解它的语言。
species.fl_en: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

species.fl: 会通过模仿人哭叫的声音来吓唬大家并以此为乐。不擅长对付胆大的对手。
species.fl_en: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

species.fl: 很像古代文明的文字。是先有文字还是先有未知图腾，这是世界七大不可思议之一。
species.fl_en: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

species.fl: 为了隐藏漆黑的尾巴而悄悄地生活在黑暗之中。不会主动发起攻击。
species.fl_en: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

species.fl: 尾巴上的脑袋虽然很小，但却是可以发挥出强大超能力的重要器官。
species.fl_en: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

species.fl: 会用唾液将树皮粘在自己身上，从而让自己变得又厚又大。上了年纪的榛果球是无比巨大的。
species.fl_en: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

species.fl: 仅在吞下猎物的瞬间，壳里面的身体才会出现，但至今仍未有人或宝可梦见过其真面目。
species.fl_en: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

species.fl: 栖息在像迷宫一样的巢穴里。能通过土壤的气味来判断自己的位置，所以绝对不会迷路。
species.fl_en: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

species.fl: 在陡峭的岩壁上筑巢。每次滑翔之后，就要跳着回到巢里。
species.fl_en: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

species.fl: 人们认为它的身体是因为堆积了很多和泥土一起吞下的铁元素，才会发生变化的。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带金属膜

species.fl: 它和看上去不同，其实很胆小。所以如果把它和小狗宝可梦放在一起，它就有可能会受到欺负。
species.fl_en: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

species.fl: 虽然深受年轻女性的欢迎，但它胆小怕事，内心柔弱，所以无法成为一条看门犬。
species.fl_en: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

species.fl: 全身上下的小针都是由鳞片变化而来的。如果被刺中的话，就会因中毒而昏迷。
species.fl_en: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

species.fl: 虽然身体纤细，却有着惊人的攻击力。身体的肌肉也是由金属构成的。
species.fl_en: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带金属膜

species.fl: 储存在壶形甲壳里的树果会在不知不觉间变成黏糊糊的果汁。
species.fl_en: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

species.fl: 能轻轻松松地举起比自己体重还重１００倍的东西，是以一身怪力为傲的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

species.fl: 狡黠凶恶的性格。趁着双亲不在就侵入巢穴，将蛋盗出。
species.fl_en: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

species.fl: 会偷偷跟踪三蜜蜂找出它们的巢，然后用手掌挖起大量蜜汁来享用。
species.fl_en: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

species.fl: 虽然看上去无所畏惧，但在舔食到最喜欢的蜜时，会高兴得笑逐颜开。
species.fl_en: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

species.fl: 由熔岩构成的身体有时会因变冷而缺损，但只要泡到熔岩中就能恢复。
species.fl_en: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

species.fl: 生活在火山口附近。由熔岩冷却凝固而成的壳里积蓄着火之能量。
species.fl_en: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

species.fl: 嗅到诱人的香味时，便会不顾一切地朝着气味的方向飞奔过去。
species.fl_en: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

species.fl: 虽然４只脚很短，但因为蹄子很宽很粗糙，所以就算在雪地上行走也不会打滑。
species.fl_en: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

species.fl: 在温暖的大海里生活。也曾经大量栖息于上古时期的伽勒尔近海。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

species.fl: 会用变成吸盘状的背鳍吸附在巨翅飞鱼身上，让它分一点吃剩的东西给自己吃。
species.fl_en: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

species.fl: 有着结实的坚硬脑袋。会用带吸盘的脚缠住对手，然后再一个劲地用头猛撞。
species.fl_en: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

species.fl: 因为有跟人类及宝可梦分享自己食物的习性，所以一直都在到处寻找食物。
species.fl_en: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

species.fl: 悠然地畅游在大海中。就算有觊觎食物残渣的铁炮鱼吸附在自己身上也毫不在意。
species.fl_en: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

species.fl: 由于它身上掉落下来的羽毛可以用来制剑，因此作为纹章的图案也很有人气。
species.fl_en: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

species.fl: 会在天亮之前反复发出恐怖的长嚎，并以此来彰显自己群体的存在。
species.fl_en: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

species.fl: 恐怖的长嚎是其特征。过去人们曾认为它是来自地狱的使者而对其心存畏惧。
species.fl_en: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

species.fl: 身上掉下的鳞片闪耀着高雅而有深度的光泽，甚至会被拿去进献给王族。
species.fl_en: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带龙之鳞片

species.fl: 会在河边做出巢穴栖息。玩泥巴之后如果不把身体洗干净，就会感到不自在。
species.fl_en: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

species.fl: 全身包覆着坚硬的皮肤，就算被车撞到也安然无恙。但是对雨却毫无招架之力。
species.fl_en: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

species.fl: 在装载了ＡＩ功能后，多边兽２型便开始用只有彼此能懂的神秘语言互相交流了。
species.fl_en: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带升级数据

species.fl: 过去生活在严苛的环境下，因此当时的精神力量似乎比现在还要强。
species.fl_en: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

species.fl: 会用尾巴前端渗出的体液画下标记。对于有些标记，爱好者会以高价买卖。
species.fl_en: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

species.fl: 体型偏小却不可轻视，因为它只要发现合适的对手便会马上扑上去大打出手。
species.fl_en: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

species.fl: 会通过倒立来扰乱对方的节奏，然后趁隙施展华丽的踢击。
species.fl_en: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

species.fl: 好奇心旺盛的宝可梦。不管是什么都会试着用嘴唇去触碰，确认是否喜欢。
species.fl_en: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

species.fl: 储存电力的本领还不到家。为了吸取电力，会偷偷潜入民宅寻找插座。
species.fl_en: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

species.fl: 栖息在火山地带。会浸泡在岩浆中，疗愈一整天的疲劳。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

species.fl: 如果不每天帮它挤鲜奶，它的身体就会不舒服。鲜奶的味道会随季节改变。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

species.fl: 会生下装满幸福的奇妙之蛋。据说，吃下它的蛋的人，能够对所有人都温柔相待。
species.fl_en: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

species.fl: 据说是和雷电一同降临的宝可梦。能够从背上的雨云放射出雷电。
species.fl_en: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

species.fl: 据说如果炎帝吼叫的话，世界上的某处火山就会喷发。
species.fl_en: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

species.fl: 在全世界四处奔跑，让污水重回清澈。会随北风奔跑着离去。
species.fl_en: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

species.fl: 以吃土为生。吃掉一座大山后，就会为了成长而开始沉睡。
species.fl_en: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

species.fl: 虽然是蛹却不会呆着不动。在坚硬的甲壳之下已经长出了手脚。
species.fl_en: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

species.fl: 当它带着巨大轰鸣声迈开脚步，就连大山都会为之崩裂，周围的地形也会因此改变。
species.fl_en: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

species.fl: 沉睡在很深的海沟底部。据说洛奇亚挥动翅膀的话，就会引起长达４０天的暴风雨。
species.fl_en: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

species.fl: 其翅膀闪耀着七种色彩。传说见到凤王的人能够拥有永远的幸福。
species.fl_en: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

species.fl: 从未来穿越时光而来。能够治愈伤痛，也会把自己的力量分给草木。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

species.fl: 脚底的小刺能钩在墙壁或天花板上，所以就算倒挂着也不会掉下来。
species.fl_en: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

species.fl: 发达的大腿肌肉会产生出惊人的爆发力和弹跳力。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

species.fl: 会轻快地在丛林里跑来跑去，并用手臂上长出的锋利叶子解决猎物。
species.fl_en: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

species.fl: 肚子里有火袋。抱在怀里暖烘烘的很温暖。只要生命尚存火焰就会持续燃烧。
species.fl_en: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

species.fl: 会发出尖锐的叫声来提高注意力。腿技的破坏力超群。
species.fl_en: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

species.fl: 遇到强敌时会从手腕喷出火焰。有着能够跃过大楼的脚力。
species.fl_en: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

species.fl: 拥有能粉碎巨大岩石的力量。会把自己的身体埋在河底的泥土中休息。
species.fl_en: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

species.fl: 生活在粘稠泥泞的地上，久而久之就锻炼出了强韧的腰腿。
species.fl_en: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

species.fl: 只要挥一挥如岩石般坚硬的手臂，就能将巨大的岩石打得粉碎。
species.fl_en: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

species.fl: 露出大大的獠牙猛吠威吓对手的行为是它性格胆小的表现。
species.fl_en: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

species.fl: 会忠实听从首领的命令。通过超群的团队合作，绝不会让盯上的猎物逃掉。
species.fl_en: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

species.fl: 伽勒尔的蛇纹熊适应了其他地区环境后的样子。十分擅长找东西。
species.fl_en: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

species.fl: 用自己超群的爆发力和锐利的爪子来制服猎物。不擅长在弯曲的道路上奔跑。
species.fl_en: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

species.fl: 非常喜欢吃叶子。受到姆克儿的袭击时，会用尾部的刺击退对方。
species.fl_en: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

species.fl: 为了不掉下来，它将身上伸出的丝线缠在树枝上以固定自身。然后一动不动地等待进化。
species.fl_en: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

species.fl: 会用细长的嘴巴刺向对手，并吸取对手的体液。生性好斗。
species.fl_en: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

species.fl: 茧内温度非常高，浑身细胞都在里面制造进化所需的能量。
species.fl_en: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

species.fl: 夜行性宝可梦。被灯光引诱的毒粉蛾会把行道树上的叶子吃得一塌糊涂。
species.fl_en: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

species.fl: 因为叶子长得太大太重，所以才会改变习性，漂浮在水面上生活。
species.fl_en: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

species.fl: 住在日照良好的水边。白天在水草做的床上睡觉，太阳下山后就会出来活动。
species.fl_en: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

species.fl: 乐天河童会跟着欢快的音乐摇摆身体，从而增强自己的力量。
species.fl_en: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

species.fl: 会将头顶粘在树枝上悬挂着。也有被大风吹落的时候。
species.fl_en: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

species.fl: 长鼻叶居住在大树上的洞穴里，它吹奏出的草笛声会让听到的人感到不安。
species.fl_en: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

species.fl: 在森林深处静静地生活。据说当它扇动大大的团扇，就会刮起冬日寒风。
species.fl_en: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

species.fl: 有着不管是怎样强大的对手都敢于前去迎战的毅力。会向着温暖的土地飞行。
species.fl_en: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

species.fl: 边在高空盘旋边搜寻猎物，发现猎物后会头朝下急速俯冲将其捕获。
species.fl_en: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

species.fl: 利用气流，不拍打翅膀就能飞上天空。会在海边的岩壁上筑巢。
species.fl_en: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

species.fl: 会贴着海面飞行，用大大的鸟嘴连着海水一起把食物捞起来带走。
species.fl_en: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

species.fl: 用红色的角捕捉到人和宝可梦的温情后，全身也会稍稍变暖起来。
species.fl_en: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

species.fl: 可以通过操纵精神力量扭曲周围的空间来看清未来。
species.fl_en: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

species.fl: 如果是为了保护训练家，它就会用尽自己的精神力量制造出小型黑洞。
species.fl_en: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

species.fl: 栖息在水草丛生的池塘或沼泽里。会经常和栖息地以及食物都与自己相近的滴蛛争斗。
species.fl_en: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

species.fl: 像薄薄的翅膀一样的触角很容易吸收湿气。雨天会静静地待在树洞等地方度过。
species.fl_en: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

species.fl: 喜欢潮湿的地方，白天会呆在森林的树荫里一动不动。会从头上放出毒粉。
species.fl_en: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

species.fl: 会撒出毒孢子，然后再让因吸入孢子而苦痛不堪的对手吃上一记重拳。
species.fl_en: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

species.fl: １天要睡２０个小时。它还有一种能力是让看着自己的对手睡意渐浓。
species.fl_en: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

species.fl: 如果不活动活动身体，压力就会堆积过度，使身体状况变糟。
species.fl_en: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

species.fl: 虽然是世界上最吊儿郎当的宝可梦，但能通过把积蓄的能量一次放出，从而发挥出惊人的力量。
species.fl_en: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

species.fl: 有时能在土里生活１０年以上。会从树木的根部那里吸取营养。
species.fl_en: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

species.fl: 行动十分迅速的宝可梦。说它无论什么攻击都能避开也不夸张。非常喜欢甘甜的树液。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

species.fl: 不拍动翅膀也能四处飞行。身体里面空空的，是一种不呼吸的奇妙宝可梦。
species.fl_en: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

species.fl: 一旦开始喊叫，就会被自己的声音惊吓到，然后以更大的声音大吼大叫起来。叫累了以后就会睡着，
species.fl_en: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

species.fl: 它发出的大叫声不仅会刺激听觉，还会压缩空气造成冲击波将敌人吹飞给予伤害。
species.fl_en: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

species.fl: 它不仅仅会大喊大叫。为了和伙伴相互传情达意，它会从身体的洞里发出各种各样的音色。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

species.fl: 据说为了培育强大的幕下力士，存在着一种训练家们按传统手法制作的火锅料理。
species.fl_en: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

species.fl: 体型粗壮的铁掌力士未必强大。即便身型矮小，也有身轻如燕，擅长巧力的铁掌力士。
species.fl_en: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

species.fl: 虽然是种性情温顺的宝可梦，但生起气来，便会嗖嗖地挥舞起尾巴上的大球来猛烈击打对手。
species.fl_en: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

species.fl: 它会一动不动地用强力的磁力将猎物吸过来狩猎。但有时也会吸到天敌。
species.fl_en: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

species.fl: 不由自主地就会去追动的东西。会追着自己的尾巴，一圈圈地原地打转。
species.fl_en: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

species.fl: 有着美丽的毛发，非常受女性训练家的欢迎。没有固定的住所。
species.fl_en: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.

species.fl: 会去吃宝石的结晶。双眼在漆黑一片的地方会发出宝石的光芒。
species.fl_en: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

species.fl: 大嘴娃能用自己那由钢角变化而成的巨大颚部将对手一口紧紧咬住。
species.fl_en: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

species.fl: 进化的时候，钢铁盔甲会全部脱落。人们曾经将其捡来活用于生活。
species.fl_en: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

species.fl: 会用钢铁之躯互相撞击来争夺地盘。仔细看会发现钢铁盔甲上有伤痕和凹陷。
species.fl_en: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

species.fl: 很久以前，有位国王由于希望像波士可多拉一样强大而戴上了模仿它的头部制成的头盔。
species.fl_en: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

species.fl: 对它来说每天的瑜伽修行是不可或缺的，会通过冥想来提高精神力。
species.fl_en: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

species.fl: 能够使用通过瑜伽修行锻炼出来的精神力量来预测对手的行动。
species.fl_en: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

species.fl: 会在体毛中储存静电。在空气干燥的季节会从全身散发出火花。
species.fl_en: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

species.fl: 极少出现在人前。据说它的住所就在雷电落下的地方。
species.fl_en: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

species.fl: 从身体撒出火花来为伙伴加油。会爬上电线杆吸取电力。
species.fl_en: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

species.fl: 负电拍拍和正电拍拍放出的电流有促进血液流动，缓解酸痛的功效。
species.fl_en: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

species.fl: 栖息在水质清澈的池塘里。到了晚上臀部就会发光，然后它会通过那闪烁的光芒来和伙伴交流。
species.fl_en: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

species.fl: 会利用甜甜的香气诱导电萤虫在夜空中描绘２００种以上的图形。
species.fl_en: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

species.fl: 会用右手和左手分别放出２种不同的毒来进行攻击。香气越浓越有精神。
species.fl_en: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

species.fl: 它的胃能消化任何东西。消化时产生的气体带有强烈的恶臭。
species.fl_en: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

species.fl: 只要是大小可以放进嘴里的东西，不管是什么都会整个吞下。能靠特殊的胃液消化任何东西。
species.fl_en: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

species.fl: 拥有锋利的牙齿和结实的下颚。水手们绝不会主动靠近利牙鱼的栖息地。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

species.fl: 被称为大海恶霸。进入它栖息海域的船只会无一例外地遭到袭击。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

species.fl: 喝入大量的海水之后，身体会鼓成像球一样。每天要吃掉１吨的食物。
species.fl_en: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

species.fl: 总之，因为超级巨大而受欢迎。观看吼鲸王在各地都是非常受欢迎的游览项目。
species.fl_en: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

species.fl: 体内燃烧着１２００度的熔岩。一旦气温变低，熔岩就会凝固。动作也会因此变得迟缓。
species.fl_en: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

species.fl: 平时生活在火山口。它背上的驼峰每１０年都会大爆发一次，便因而闻名。
species.fl_en: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

species.fl: 在弃用的煤矿中住着很多煤炭龟，它们会不停地挖掘煤炭。
species.fl_en: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

species.fl: 如果不保持跳动就会死亡。头上戴着的珍珠能让自己的精神力量增强。
species.fl_en: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

species.fl: 它在操纵对手时所跳的奇异舞步，过去曾在外国掀起一阵风潮。
species.fl_en: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

species.fl: 每一只身上的斑点花纹都不同。会用晃晃悠悠的动作绝妙地躲避对手的攻击。
species.fl_en: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

species.fl: 建造了绝对无法逃脱的捣蒜钵状巢穴，并在巢穴里等着猎物自己掉进来。
species.fl_en: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

species.fl: 为了让翅膀成长，每天要用消化液溶化并吸食大量的猎物。
species.fl_en: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

species.fl: 由于它挥动翅膀的声音好似女性优美的歌声，因此被称为沙漠精灵。
species.fl_en: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

species.fl: 喜欢沙漠之类的严酷环境。靠体内储存的水分可以生存３０天。
species.fl_en: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

species.fl: 会成群结队跟在沙漠旅行者的身后，并一直等到他累得无法动弹为止。
species.fl_en: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

species.fl: 看起来像是一团棉花云，因此不易被敌人发现。据说翅膀是随着世代演进逐渐变白的。
species.fl_en: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

species.fl: 虽然性情温顺，但如果被惹怒，就会用尖锐的叫声威吓对方，并且毫不留情地发动进攻。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

species.fl: 与饭匙蛇是死对头。一旦遇到，就会立刻张开前脚的爪子来威吓对方。
species.fl_en: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

species.fl: 会用坚硬的岩石来打磨刀刃般的尾巴。会躲在草丛里，趁猎物靠近时用毒牙袭击。
species.fl_en: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

species.fl: 第一次发现它是在４０年前陨石坠落的地方。只要注视敌人就能使其入睡。
species.fl_en: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

species.fl: 太阳能量是其力量之源，所以白天会很强。旋转时身体会发光。
species.fl_en: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

species.fl: 会用２根长长的胡须探索浑浊的河底。用湿滑的粘膜保护着身体。
species.fl_en: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

species.fl: 会将大沼泽划为自己的领地。如果有敌人接近的话，它就会狂暴起来，并引发大地震。
species.fl_en: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

species.fl: 来自于外国的宝可梦，现在已经回归了野生环境。不管多么污浊的河水都能适应。
species.fl_en: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

species.fl: 有着热爱战斗的性格。当遇到靠近自己领地的对手，会毫不留情地将之打倒。
species.fl_en: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

species.fl: 在古代遗迹被发现。会一边旋转一边移动。晚上睡觉的时候也是单脚站着。
species.fl_en: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

species.fl: 似乎是从古代人做的泥偶诞生而来的宝可梦。能靠念力浮在空中移动。
species.fl_en: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

species.fl: 会吸附在海底岩石上，用花瓣一样的触手缠住接近自己的猎物。
species.fl_en: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

species.fl: 用触手将猎物缠住后，会用消化液将其溶化，然后吸收其中的养分。
species.fl_en: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

species.fl: 会把８根翅膀当做船桨划水，并且游泳的速度相当快。是虫宝可梦的一种祖先。
species.fl_en: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

species.fl: 栖息在陆地，但也擅长游泳。会潜入大海寻找猎物，用锋利的爪子给予致命一击。
species.fl_en: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

species.fl: 虽然外表丑陋，但拥有顽强的生命力，只要少量的水就能存活。
species.fl_en: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

species.fl: 据说目睹了美纳斯美丽身姿的人，心中一切的愤恨都能得到抚慰。
species.fl_en: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带美丽鳞片

species.fl: 样子会根据天气发生变化。天气越恶劣，性格也会变得越暴躁。
species.fl_en: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

species.fl: 在不隐身的时候，身体的颜色也会随着心情和状态改变。颜色越浓的时候越有精神。
species.fl_en: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

species.fl: 流传着这样的古老俗语，日暮时分，不要去排列着怨影娃娃的房子。
species.fl_en: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

species.fl: 因被丢弃的怨念而诞生。听说，如果满足它受重视的需求，就会变回原来的玩偶。
species.fl_en: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

species.fl: 会让身体变透明，然后偷偷地靠近猎物。拥有穿过厚墙壁的能力。
species.fl_en: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

species.fl: 寻找游走的灵魂，吸入自己空洞的身体里。没人知道被吸入后会发生什么事。
species.fl_en: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

species.fl: 脖子上的那串水果很美味，很受欢迎。在温暖的地方，有许多培育热带龙的牧场。
species.fl_en: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

species.fl: 用头部的吸盘悬挂在树枝或是房子的屋檐下。会灵活运用７种音色。
species.fl_en: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

species.fl: 由于拥有感知危险的能力，因此它被人们误解为是会招来灾祸的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

species.fl: 具有集体行动的习性。睡觉的时候会聚集在洞窟中，和伙伴们把身体挨在一起。
species.fl_en: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

species.fl: 只能在寒冷的土地上生存。即使在零下１００度的环境下也能充满活力地到处蹦蹦跳跳。
species.fl_en: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

species.fl: 用令空气中的水分瞬间冻结的力量，将猎物冰冻起来。
species.fl_en: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

species.fl: 会漂浮在波浪当中观察大海的状况。一旦发现猎物，就会通知群体里的帝牙海狮。
species.fl_en: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

species.fl: 不管是海豹球还是精灵球，只要是圆的物体都会顶在鼻子上转来转去。
species.fl_en: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

species.fl: 它的獠牙一生都会持续生长。即使在战斗中被折断也能逐渐恢复，只需要１年的时间便能完好如初。
species.fl_en: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

species.fl: 珍珠贝的珍珠非常贵重。据说，其价值或许是大舌贝珍珠的１０倍以上。
species.fl_en: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

species.fl: 栖息在深海中。传说，如果猎斑鱼被冲上沙滩，就会有不祥的事情发生。
species.fl_en: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带深海之牙

species.fl: 吸食猎物的体液。剩下的肉会沉入海底，成为其他宝可梦的食物。
species.fl_en: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带深海鳞片

species.fl: 在深海调查中被发现的宝可梦。样子在１亿年间都没有任何变化，被人们称为活化石。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

species.fl: 温暖海域的珊瑚礁是它的栖息地。特别喜欢在太阳珊瑚的枝条间睡觉。
species.fl_en: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

species.fl: 不会成群结队，喜欢单独生活。脑袋很硬，只要猛地一撞，就能把坚硬的岩石一分为二。
species.fl_en: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

species.fl: 可以不吃食物忍受饥饿。据说当它用尽积蓄的能量后，就会开始进化。
species.fl_en: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

species.fl: 虽然在空中翱翔能够让它乐在其中，但是一旦被惹怒，就会大闹一番，不可收拾。
species.fl_en: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

species.fl: 身体的细胞由磁铁构成。循环于全身的不是血液，而是磁力。
species.fl_en: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

species.fl: 依靠磁力飞行。能够在空中以高速穿过险峻的山岳，让追捕的猎物无处可逃。
species.fl_en: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

species.fl: ２只金属怪组合起来的样子。运用堪比超级计算机的头脑打败敌人。
species.fl_en: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

species.fl: 人们通过最新的科学技术对它的岩石身体做了调查，但是并未发现大脑和心脏。
species.fl_en: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

species.fl: 拥有一副由冰构成的身体。据说是诞生于冰河时期冻得厚厚实实的冰块之下。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

species.fl: 据说诞生于地幔之中，在距今约１万年前现身于地面之上。
species.fl_en: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

species.fl: 通过心灵感应交流情感。用能令光发生折射的羽毛包裹身体来让自己隐形。飞行能力和攻击力提升。会撒下透明的羽毛扰乱敌人。（超级进化）
species.fl_en: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

species.fl: 拥有很高的智商，能理解人类的语言。是讨厌争斗且温柔的宝可梦。飞行速度超过４马赫。拥有在宝可梦中顶级的空中战斗力。（超级进化）
species.fl_en: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

species.fl: 神话中的宝可梦，它用大雨和大海啸扩张海洋。曾与固拉多激烈交战。通过拥有原始世界的能量的靛蓝色宝珠回归而来。肉体就像是海水一样。（原始回归）
species.fl_en: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

species.fl: 据说能用高温蒸发水分扩张大地。曾与盖欧卡激烈交战。借由朱红色宝珠复活的原本的样子。能量化作岩浆，从身体里面溢出。（原始回归）
species.fl_en: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

species.fl: 因为栖息在高高的云层之上的臭氧层，所以从地面无法看见它的样子。夜空中闪耀的流星可能是超级烈空坐追逐陨石飞舞的身姿。（超级进化）
species.fl_en: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

species.fl: 传说当它从１０００年的沉睡中醒来时，会实现写在它头部许愿笺上的愿望。
species.fl_en: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

species.fl: 附着在陨石上的宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ变异后生成的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

species.fl: 触摸背上由泥土构成的甲壳时，如果感觉到湿润度适中，就证明那只草苗龟非常健康。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

species.fl: 据说生活在森林的树林龟有着自己才知道位置的清澈涌泉。
species.fl_en: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

species.fl: 在遥远的过去，人们曾假想过，在大地的下面存在着巨大土台龟。
species.fl_en: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

species.fl: 身轻如燕的宝可梦。为了不点燃附近的东西，会先灭掉屁股上的火焰再睡觉。
species.fl_en: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

species.fl: 能熟练控制尾部火焰的大小，以自己擅长的距离进行战斗。
species.fl_en: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

species.fl: 用速度玩弄对手。会使用手脚并用的独特战斗方式。
species.fl_en: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

species.fl: 不擅长走路，有时还会跌到，但波加曼强烈的自尊心会让它挺起胸膛，毫不在意。
species.fl_en: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

species.fl: 不结交伙伴，独自生活。翅膀的强烈一击能把大树一劈两半。
species.fl_en: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

species.fl: 伤害到它自尊心的家伙，会被它用能切断浮冰的翅膀一分为二。
species.fl_en: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

species.fl: 以庞大的群体在山野间飞来飞去，追捕虫宝可梦。叫声非常吵闹。
species.fl_en: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

species.fl: 对自己的弱小心知肚明，所以平时总是群体生活。独处时会发出吵闹的叫声。
species.fl_en: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

species.fl: 变为姆克鹰后，就会脱离群体独自生活。拥有强韧的翅膀。
