species.fl_en: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

species.fl: 遇到任何事都不慌不忙，神经很大条的家伙。能做出与外表不符的灵敏动作。
species.fl_en: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

species.fl: 用树干和泥巴筑坝堵住河流，建造住所。以勤劳而闻名。
species.fl_en: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

species.fl: 每当腿短的它快要跌倒时，坚硬的触角就会互相摩擦，发出如木琴般的声音。
species.fl_en: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

species.fl: 通过让声音在体内的空洞回响来使自己的叫声变得悦耳。
species.fl_en: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

species.fl: 体毛通电后就会发光。会摇晃明亮发光的尾巴尖端来向伙伴发送信号。
species.fl_en: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

species.fl: 遇到敌人时会从脚伸出有着百万伏特威力的爪子来迎战。
species.fl_en: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

species.fl: 由于透视需要消耗大量的电能，因此它会睡很长时间来积蓄能量。
species.fl_en: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

species.fl: 对气温的变化很敏感。当它开始打开花苞，便是冬去春来之时。
species.fl_en: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

species.fl: 右手的毒是速效的，左手的毒则是慢性的。无论哪边的毒性都能致命。
species.fl_en: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

species.fl: 坚硬的头盖骨是其特征。会用头锤撞断树木，吃树上结的树果。
species.fl_en: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

species.fl: 擅长头锤的古代宝可梦。因为大脑真的很小，所以也有说法它是因愚笨而灭亡的。
species.fl_en: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

species.fl: 虽然从太古时代的地层中发现了它的化石，但尚未发现除了脸以外的部分。
species.fl_en: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

species.fl: 大约１亿年前的宝可梦。极其结实的脸有着超越钢铁的硬度。
species.fl_en: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

species.fl: 为了抵御寒冷的秋风，会用小树枝和落叶当材料，做成蓑衣裹在身上。
species.fl_en: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

species.fl: 从结草儿进化过来时，蓑衣成为了身体的一部分。一辈子都不会脱下蓑衣。
species.fl_en: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

species.fl: 非常喜欢吃花蜜。会抢夺三蜜蜂采集到的蜜，然后自己吃掉。
species.fl_en: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

species.fl: 从早到晚都在采集花蜜。这一切都是为了自己的族群和蜂女王。
species.fl_en: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

species.fl: 能释放越多费洛蒙的蜂女王，就能让越多的三蜜蜂听从自己的指挥。
species.fl_en: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

species.fl: 像螺旋桨一样旋转着尾巴，不仅能让它在水里游泳，还能切断缠住自己的海草。
species.fl_en: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

species.fl: 浮囊膨胀起来后，就能让人乘坐在背上。会排出浮囊的气来潜水。
species.fl_en: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

species.fl: 身体越红的樱花宝含有的营养越丰富，味道也很甜很好吃。
species.fl_en: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

species.fl: 盖起来的花瓣很硬。即使被鸟宝可梦啄到，也完全没问题。
species.fl_en: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

species.fl: 如果用力按住它，它就会分泌出神秘的紫色液体。虽然液体无害，不过黏糊糊的。
species.fl_en: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

species.fl: 身体软瘫瘫的但十分强韧。因为它身体的软度可以帮助分散它所受到的冲击。
species.fl_en: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

species.fl: 无论做什么都会用到尾巴。如果被它的２条尾巴抱紧，那就证明是真的和你很亲近。
species.fl_en: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

species.fl: 因魂魄聚集在一起而诞生。到了湿气大的季节就有可能大量出现。
species.fl_en: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

species.fl: 会抓住人和宝可梦，然后运到某个地方。没人知道那地方是哪里。
species.fl_en: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

species.fl: 会利用把卷卷的耳朵伸直时产生的威力进行攻击。越训练，这一招式的威力就越强。
species.fl_en: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

species.fl: 当高温的季节结束后，就会换上富含空气的体毛，准备抵御寒冷。
species.fl_en: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

species.fl: 会吟诵诅咒的语言，让对方极度头疼，或是看到恐怖的幻觉，深受折磨。
species.fl_en: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

species.fl: 和敌人战斗的基本都是跟班。只有在最后刺入对手的致命一击才会弄脏自己的手。
species.fl_en: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

species.fl: 一不称心，就会竖起爪子。但偶尔会从喉咙里发出声响来撒娇，这样的性格很受部分人喜爱。
species.fl_en: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

species.fl: 脸皮极厚，即使是其他宝可梦的住处，也会大摇大摆地进去睡起觉来。
species.fl_en: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

species.fl: 如果跳起来，嘴里的珠子就会弹来弹去，发出铃铛一般的音色。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

species.fl: 要是它翘起尾巴把屁股对准了你，请一定要小心。因为这表示它将要喷出足以让人窒息的臭液。
species.fl_en: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

species.fl: 从尾巴尖端喷出的液体带有强烈的恶臭。会在地面上挖洞建造巢穴。
species.fl_en: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

species.fl: 虽然人们说把铜镜怪打磨到发光，它就能映照出真相，但其实它非常讨厌被打磨。
species.fl_en: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

species.fl: 它身上的纹路让许多学者都认为它原本并不存在于伽勒尔。
species.fl_en: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

species.fl: 栖息在空气干燥岩石裸露的地方。空气越是干燥，它身上的绿球就越是会泛出暗淡的光泽。
species.fl_en: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

species.fl: 像徒弟一样跟随着擅长跳舞的踏冰人偶，拼命模仿它的舞步。
species.fl_en: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

species.fl: 会把自己珍贵的浑圆石头借给关系变得很要好的对象。如果不还给它，它便会大哭大闹。
species.fl_en: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

species.fl: 学习人类的语言来鸣叫。当伙伴们聚集在同一个地方时，大家就会学习到同样的词汇。
species.fl_en: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

species.fl: 总是作恶多端，于是被使用神奇法术的旅人绑缚在楔石里。
species.fl_en: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

species.fl: 遇到会动的东西就会扑上去将其拉回到自己住的横洞内。虽然嘴很大，但胃口却比较小。
species.fl_en: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

species.fl: 会把宝石埋藏在栖息的洞窟内。入侵者闯入洞窟后，会立刻被它用爪子和牙齿撕碎。
species.fl_en: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

species.fl: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷，在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前干掉猎物并返回住处。
species.fl_en: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

species.fl: 在体毛下面储存食物。如果是自己信赖的对象，也会把食物分给对方一口。
species.fl_en: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

species.fl: 除了能读懂对手的感情，也能以“波导”这种形式的波来观察大自然的样子。
species.fl_en: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

species.fl: 他能理解人类的想法，因此只会去亲近内心端正的训练家。
species.fl_en: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

species.fl: 主要在白天活动。因为沙漠的夜晚会降温，所以会钻到沙子的深处睡觉。
species.fl_en: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

species.fl: 生气的时候非常凶暴。会喷出储存在体内的沙子来引发沙尘暴。
species.fl_en: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

species.fl: 用尾巴上带毒的钩爪袭击对手。一旦被夹住，毒素就会扩散开来，导致全身无法动弹。
species.fl_en: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

species.fl: 虽然狰狞凶猛到被人们称为沙之恶魔，但在河马兽面前却表现得低调温顺。
species.fl_en: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

species.fl: 毒素在稀释后能制成药品。它是制药公司的吉祥物，广受众人的欢迎。
species.fl_en: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

species.fl: 制服了猎物之后，便会呱呱地发出胜利的欢呼。与蟾蜍王是相近的物种。
species.fl_en: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

species.fl: 先用甜香的唾液引诱猎物，然后用大颚大口地嚼。要花１整天吃掉猎物。
species.fl_en: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

species.fl: 用发光的尾鳍引诱猎物。白天会在海面附近，到了夜里就向海的深处移动。
species.fl_en: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

species.fl: 像是爬行一样在深海的海底游泳。鳍上发出的充满幻想的光就像是夜空的星星。
species.fl_en: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

species.fl: 混在铁炮鱼的大群里游泳。受到敌人袭击的时候，会和铁炮鱼们并肩作战。
species.fl_en: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

species.fl: 雪笠怪肚子上结出来的口感好似冰棍的树果是伽勒尔的火红不倒翁们的最爱。
species.fl_en: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

species.fl: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。只要它摇动巨大的身体，周围立刻会变得一片雪白。
species.fl_en: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

species.fl: 通过用爪子留下记号来与伙伴联络。据说记号的种类有５００种以上。
species.fl_en: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.
species.evo: 携带锐利之爪 夜晚

species.fl: 人们认为，它是因为受到特殊磁场的影响，身体的分子构造发生了变化，才进化成这样的。
species.fl_en: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

species.fl: 舌头的灵巧程度甚至不输给人手，没有它做不到的事。相反，手指却相当笨拙，
species.fl_en: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

species.fl: 用护具弹开敌人的攻击，在对手畏缩时用自己引以为傲的钻头贯穿对方。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带护具

species.fl: 栖息的地域越是温暖，藤蔓生长得就越快。藤蔓变长后，它会亲手将其扯断使其变短。
species.fl_en: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

species.fl: 发电量在电气宝可梦当中属于最高级别。可以从尾巴尖端释放高压电流。
species.fl_en: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带电力增幅器

species.fl: 由于栖息在火山口，因此身体逐渐变得像火山一样，还长着类似岩浆库的器官。
species.fl_en: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带熔岩增幅器

species.fl: 被称为会带来恩惠的宝可梦，从很久很久以前开始，人们就视它为吉祥之物。
species.fl_en: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

species.fl: 拍动翅膀的力量极强，在用力起飞时，会掀倒周围的巨树。
species.fl_en: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

species.fl: 尾巴好似锐利的刀刃，锋利得无与伦比，连大树都能一斩为二。
species.fl_en: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

species.fl: 冰伊布释放出的冷气能制造出粉状的雪。这使它受到各个滑雪场的热烈欢迎。
species.fl_en: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

species.fl: 只要顺利乘上微风，哪怕一次翅膀都不拍，也能环绕这个星球一周。
species.fl_en: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.
species.evo: 携带锐利之牙 夜晚

species.fl: 它的力量就如外表那样强大。天气越是寒冷，它的冰牙就会长得越粗、越长、越结实。
species.fl_en: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

species.fl: 有人说它是通过追加程序进化的，但关于它的改变是否真是进化，在学会中也存在着意见分歧。
species.fl_en: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带可疑补丁

species.fl: 能够敏锐地感知到寻求帮助的感情，并且火速赶去援助对方。
species.fl_en: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.
species.evo: 使用觉醒之石 雌性

species.fl: 使用３个小部件获取食物，或是和敌人战斗。本体基本上只负责下命令。
species.fl_en: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

species.fl: 用腹部的嘴将猎物整个吞下。只会吃掉对方的魂魄，离去时会把肉体吐出来。
species.fl_en: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带灵界之布

species.fl: 会吐出零下５０度的冷气冻住猎物，并把它们带回自己的巢穴，整齐地摆成一排。
species.fl_en: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.
species.evo: 使用觉醒之石 雄性

species.fl: 会用由离子构成的身体潜入各种各样的机器里。最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
species.fl_en: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

species.fl: 被称为知识之神。据说拥有消除与之目光交会者的记忆的力量。
species.fl_en: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

species.fl: 教会了人们悲伤的痛苦和快乐的宝贵。被称为感情之神。
species.fl_en: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

species.fl: 被称为意志之神。一直沉睡在湖底，维持着世界的平衡。
species.fl_en: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

species.fl: 拥有操纵时间的力量，在神奥地区的神话里被描述成神。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

species.fl: 拥有扭曲空间的能力，在神奥地区的神话里被描述成神。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

species.fl: 像熔岩般沸腾的血液在体内流动着。栖息在火山的洞穴里。据说它在火力全开时体温会升高到１００万度，决不允许敌人靠近。（超级进化）
species.fl_en: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

species.fl: 据说它用各种各样的材料制作了宝可梦后，把大陆移动到了现在的位置。
species.fl_en: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

species.fl: 据说这种宝可梦栖息在位于这个世界背面的世界里。会出现在古代的墓地中。
species.fl_en: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

species.fl: 飞行的时候，会从薄纱一样的翅膀中发出闪光粒子。被称为新月的化身。
species.fl_en: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

species.fl: 栖息在温暖的海里。会让头部的浮囊膨胀起来，漂浮在波涛间寻找食物。
species.fl_en: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

species.fl: 出生于冰冷的海底。为了回到自己出生的海底，它会游上非常长的距离。
species.fl_en: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

species.fl: 拥有诱使人们进入深度睡眠并做梦的能力。在朔月的夜晚活动。黑暗力量会遮蔽太阳，使周围全部陷入黑暗。谁都无法逃离它的邪眼。（超级进化）
species.fl_en: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

species.fl: 生活在花圃中，只要把身体蜷成团，看起来就像花一样，任谁都察觉不到。
species.fl_en: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

species.fl: 神话里将它描述为用１０００只手创造了宇宙的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

species.fl: 是会带来胜利的宝可梦。据说带着比克提尼的训练家会赢得任何对战。
species.fl_en: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

species.fl: 当尾巴的叶子受到日照制造出能量后，动作就会变得敏捷，招式也会更加强劲。
species.fl_en: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

species.fl: 能将由阳光制造出的能量在长长的身体内增强至原本的数十倍。
species.fl_en: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

species.fl: 能以有别外表的轻巧动作玩弄敌人。可从左右两个鼻孔连续发射出火球。
species.fl_en: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

species.fl: 战斗时会热血沸腾。体温会急速上升，然后变成灼热的火球。
species.fl_en: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

species.fl: 在胸内熊熊燃烧的火焰从颚部猛烈地喷出，形成了火焰的胡须。
species.fl_en: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

species.fl: 会把腹部的扇贝贝如同小刀般使用，接了敌人的招式后会立马切斩反击。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

species.fl: 它将２枚扇贝贝运用得行云流水的动作，据说被人们当作了剑术的范本。
species.fl_en: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

species.fl: 拔刀术的高手。会用收在前腿铠甲里的大刀一剑定胜负。
species.fl_en: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

species.fl: 会在颊囊里藏食物，连续放哨好几天。用尾巴给伙伴发出暗号。
species.fl_en: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

species.fl: 用体内的发光物质让眼珠和身体闪闪发光，使来袭的敌人畏缩。
species.fl_en: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

species.fl: 比普通的小孩子还要聪明许多。对于得到的关爱和受到的伤害都不会忘怀。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

species.fl: 覆盖在身上的黑色体毛既厚又有弹性，甚至能把尖锐的牙齿也反弹回去。
species.fl_en: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

species.fl: 以自己气派的胡须为傲。据说，每只个体在族群中的地位，就是根据胡须长度来决定的。
species.fl_en: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

species.fl: 会用可爱的动作让对手放下戒心，趁对方靠过来时冷不防地用爪子猛抓，然后得意地大笑。
species.fl_en: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

species.fl: 和猾大狐争抢地盘。能够悄无声息地从背后偷偷靠近猎物。
species.fl_en: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

species.fl: 会把头上的叶子分给没有精神的宝可梦。具有缓解疲劳的效果。
species.fl_en: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

species.fl: 性格粗暴，会挥动着带有尖刺的尾巴战斗。头上的叶子非常苦。
species.fl_en: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

species.fl: 智商很高，有着将树果烤熟后再吃的习性。很喜爱给人类帮忙。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 兴奋的时候，从头和尾巴飞扬起火花，身体变热。不知为何，很喜欢吃甜的东西。
species.fl_en: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

species.fl: 头上的毛发丛里储藏的水充满了营养。会用尾巴给草木浇这种水。
species.fl_en: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

species.fl: 喜欢水很干净的地方。一旦头上储藏的水减少，就会用尾巴吸水来补充。
species.fl_en: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

species.fl: 在吃掉梦之后会吐出烟雾。吃了快乐的梦时，烟雾是粉红色的；如果是噩梦，烟雾则是黑灰色的。
species.fl_en: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

species.fl: 总是在打瞌睡做梦。刚睡醒的时候会闹脾气，所以最好别去招惹它。
species.fl_en: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

species.fl: 虽然既健忘又不太聪明，因为性格认真且容易亲近人，所以受到了许多训练家的喜爱。
species.fl_en: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

species.fl: 头脑聪明而且记性很好。似乎有许多快递员将它选为自己的搭档。
species.fl_en: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

species.fl: 头脑聪明，所以自尊心也强。如果能成为高傲雉鸡的训练家，所有人都会对你刮目相看。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

species.fl: 用心跳来发电。受惊导致心跳加速时，电压也会随之上升。
species.fl_en: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

species.fl: 性格暴躁充满攻击性。兴奋起来时，就会让鬃毛亮起黄色光芒并放出电击。
species.fl_en: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

species.fl: 会对声音产生反应而动起来。在能量核心的影响下，它摸起来暖暖的。
species.fl_en: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

species.fl: 通过声音来探测四周。要是惹它生气了，它会连身体方向也不转就朝你追来。
species.fl_en: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

species.fl: 它射出的能量弹具有可以击飞翻斗车的破坏力。不过只有在晴天才能射击。
species.fl_en: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

species.fl: 一边发出超音波，一边飞来飞去寻找虫宝可梦来填饱自己的肚子。
species.fl_en: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

species.fl: 据说有些地区的人觉得它鼻子的形状很吉利，而把它当成幸福的象征来祭拜。
species.fl_en: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

species.fl: 会用爪子在地底挖掘前进。一些农民因为担心它会因此糟蹋蔬菜而讨厌它。
species.fl_en: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

species.fl: 别名钻头王。在地底下挖掘前进的速度达到了每小时１５０公里。
species.fl_en: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

species.fl: 心地善良的宝可梦。通过触角接触，就能了解对方的心情和身体状况。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

species.fl: 如果搬运小匠可以搬起自己体重３倍左右的方材，就代表它进化的日子要到了。
species.fl_en: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

species.fl: 能够灵巧地操纵工字钢。虽然对拆除得心应手，但却不太擅长组装。
species.fl_en: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

species.fl: 要是认真起来就会扔掉手中的混凝土柱，赤手空拳地扑向敌人。
species.fl_en: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

species.fl: 通过音波来联系伙伴。人类和其他宝可梦都听不见它发出的警告声。
species.fl_en: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

species.fl: 有时也会发出悦耳的叫声。身上突起物越大的蓝蟾蜍越能在更广的音域来鸣叫。
species.fl_en: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

species.fl: 在老年人之间广受欢迎。因为他们觉得它身上的瘤发出的震动拿来按摩刚刚好。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

species.fl: ５只一组一起努力练习。在练习中掉队的投摔鬼会扔掉带子离开团队。
species.fl_en: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

species.fl: 不断重复练习的打击鬼所使出的空手劈拥有足以劈开大海的破坏力。
species.fl_en: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

species.fl: 会仿照保姆虫为它穿上的叶子衣服，有样学样地啃咬树叶制作衣服。
species.fl_en: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

species.fl: 会在树木根部静静生活。比起新鲜的叶子，更爱吃变软的落叶。
species.fl_en: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

species.fl: 性格温厚且保护欲强。叶子般的手臂锋利得能将大树一刀两断。
species.fl_en: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

species.fl: 牙齿上有剧毒。一旦发现看上去能吃的猎物，就会不假思索地扑上去。
species.fl_en: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

species.fl: 用坚硬的壳和带毒的刺保护自己的身体，积蓄进化所需的能量。
species.fl_en: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

species.fl: 会和焚焰蚣激烈地争夺领地。输掉的那一方会成为另一方的猎物。
species.fl_en: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

species.fl: 将木棉球和白蓬蓬的棉花混合后编织出的布料极其精致，因此常被高级品牌选用。
species.fl_en: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

species.fl: 每当沐浴阳光，身上的棉花就会膨胀。如果膨胀过了头，它就会把棉花扯开到处乱撒。
species.fl_en: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

species.fl: 叶子的颜色越深就越健康。有时也会在被精心照料过的田地或花坛里定居下来。
species.fl_en: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

species.fl: 用它的花朵制成的精油虽有着极致香气，但价格同时也贵得令人大跌眼镜。
species.fl_en: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

species.fl: 从前也曾经登上餐桌。红条纹野蛮鲈鱼的肉脂肪含量高，适合年轻人食用。
species.fl_en: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

species.fl: 个头虽小，腰腿却很有力。会拨开沙子，在沙漠里犹如游泳般地自在移动。
species.fl_en: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

species.fl: 虽然拥有能在黑暗中看清事物的特殊双眼，但由于沙漠的夜晚寒冷，所以一般不怎么活动。
species.fl_en: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

species.fl: 虽然凶暴，但也有擅长忍耐的一面。为了捕获猎物，可以在沙子里静静等上好几天。
species.fl_en: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

species.fl: 在它睡觉的时候，无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。
species.fl_en: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

species.fl: 体内的火焰燃得越旺，力量就越大。火焰的温度有时甚至能超过１４００度。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 一年散播一次种子。花的种子营养十足，是沙漠中贵重的食粮。
species.fl_en: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

species.fl: 如果找不到大小合适的石头来当成自己的家，它也会住到河马兽的洞里。
species.fl_en: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

species.fl: 厚实的钳子是它最大的武器。硬度高到甚至能让超甲狂犀的护具裂开。
species.fl_en: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

species.fl: 用结实的皮保护身体。据说在皮伸展到极限时，它就会开始进化。
species.fl_en: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

species.fl: 虽然性格非常粗鲁，但也有重视家族、伙伴和领地的另一面。
species.fl_en: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

species.fl: 人们在象征鸟飞过的沙漠的地下调查，结果在那里发现了疑似古代都市的遗迹。
species.fl_en: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

species.fl: 古代人的灵魂变成了宝可梦。为了寻找认得自己长相的人而在遗迹里徘徊。
species.fl_en: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

species.fl: 迭失棺象征着国王的财富，因此许多古墓里都有它的壁画。
species.fl_en: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

species.fl: 由化石复活的宝可梦。人们认为它是很多龟宝可梦的祖先。
species.fl_en: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

species.fl: 虽然和在水中相比动作会变得迟缓，但是为了寻找猎物也会登上陆地活动。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

species.fl: 被称为鸟宝可梦的祖先。栖息在树上，以树果和虫宝可梦为食。
species.fl_en: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

species.fl: 虽然也会飞行，但是似乎更擅长在地面上捕捉猎物。
species.fl_en: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

species.fl: 诞生于塞满垃圾的垃圾袋里。它嘴里喷出的毒气是伽勒尔双弹瓦斯的最爱。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

species.fl: 从右臂喷出的毒液十分危险，虚弱的生物只要一沾到，立刻就会丢掉性命。
species.fl_en: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

species.fl: 为了寻找食物，有时甚至会幻化成人类出现在城镇里。多数情况下会幻化成小孩。
species.fl_en: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

species.fl: 孤独的训练家会命令索罗亚克为自己展现幻像，借以排遣孤身一人的寂寞。
species.fl_en: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

species.fl: 用尾巴互相抚摸来打招呼。尾巴的毛比较蓬松的那一方会表现得稍微威风些。
species.fl_en: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

species.fl: 覆盖着特别油脂的毛发可以挡住攻击。这种油以高价在市场上流通。
species.fl_en: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

species.fl: 哥德宝宝会在看似无人的地方轻声地叫。它好像是在与某种只有它才看得见的东西说话。
species.fl_en: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

species.fl: 哥德小童的精神力量似乎会在星光闪耀的夜晚达到最高点。它与宇宙的关系至今不明。
species.fl_en: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

species.fl: 从哥德小姐那里看到了自己下场的恶人在那之后便销声匿迹了。
species.fl_en: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

species.fl: 身体被特殊的液体包裹着，许多人因此认为它即使在宇宙中也能存活。
species.fl_en: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

species.fl: 由于它一分为二的大脑思考的内容几乎完全不同，导致它的行动非常难以预测。
species.fl_en: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

species.fl: 虽然有人说只要喝掉它特殊的液体就能得到智慧，但对人造细胞卵以外来说，那其实是剧毒。
species.fl_en: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

species.fl: 还不擅长飞行。会看着双亲舞天鹅跳舞来学习如何拍动翅膀。
species.fl_en: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

species.fl: 会以群体的首领为中心，跳出丝丝入扣的舞蹈来提升凝聚力哦。
species.fl_en: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

species.fl: 据说它是从冰柱中诞生的。为了能让自己生活得更舒适，会吐出零下５０度的冷气冻住四周。
species.fl_en: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

species.fl: 性格和善，虽然会用零下１００度的冷气冻住敌人，但并不会伤及它们的性命。
species.fl_en: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

species.fl: 体温在零下６度左右。据说是由２只多多冰贴在一起而诞生的。
species.fl_en: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 气味会随着季节而改变，初春的气味略带甘甜，能使情绪稳定下来。（春天的样子）为了防止田地被它入侵，许多农家会拜托它的天敌，也就是鬃岩狼人来站岗。（夏天的样子）它拥有毫不怕生的性格，因此在人类面前也是我行我素。只要给它食物就能立刻拉近关系。（秋天的样子）四季鹿的体味会随季节而变，但当它是冬天的样子时，却几乎没有任何气味。（冬天的样子）
species.fl_en: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

species.fl: 角上的花很多的萌芽鹿由于会被花抢走养分，从而成长速度略显缓慢。（春天的样子）拥有很多爱好者的宝可梦。人们认为它角上的枝叶越厚越大就代表越雄伟。（夏天的样子）拥有很多爱好者的宝可梦。人们认为它角上垂下的枝叶越红就代表越气派。（秋天的样子）当它是这个样子时会比较稳重，容易驯化，是与它成为同伴的好机会。（冬天的样子）
species.fl_en: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

species.fl: 最喜欢甜甜的树果。有时也会因为在脸颊的袋子里囤了太多食物而无法好好飞行。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

species.fl: 用嘴里吐出的液体来溶化小嘴蜗的壳，只会去吃里面的身体。
species.fl_en: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

species.fl: 会举起长矛突击敌人。有一幅名画描绘着它和葱游兵决斗的场景。
species.fl_en: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.
species.evo: 通信交换 与小嘴蜗交换

species.fl: 从双手喷出的孢子虽然含有剧毒，但据说彻底干燥后可以用作治疗肠胃的药。
species.fl_en: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

species.fl: 平常一般不太动。只是一动不动地待在掉落于地面的精灵球旁边。
species.fl_en: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

species.fl: 据流传至今的传说里所述，它是由沉没到海底的古代都市的居民变成的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

species.fl: 每到满月时，胖嘟嘟会成群结队地来到海面上。这么做是为了等待猎物上门。
species.fl_en: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

species.fl: 之所以会救助体弱的宝可梦，好像是因为盯上它们的宝可梦也会攻击它自己。
species.fl_en: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

species.fl: 会附在其他宝可梦身上吸取静电。经常会把自己贴在来电汪的屁股上。
species.fl_en: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

species.fl: 为了捕捉不太会飞的幼鸟，会在鸟宝可梦的巢穴附近用带电的丝设下陷阱。
species.fl_en: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

species.fl: 偏爱长着青苔的洞窟。青苔中所含的酶能使它的尖刺成长得又大又结实。
species.fl_en: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

species.fl: 拥有比钢铁还坚硬的尖刺。会利用触手上的尖刺攀附在岩壁上移动。
species.fl_en: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

species.fl: 据说在很久以前，是看到了齿轮儿的人发明了齿轮的构造。
species.fl_en: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

species.fl: 被认为是工业技术的象征。有许多伽勒尔当地的公司选择它作为企业的标志。
species.fl_en: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

species.fl: 让３个齿轮高速旋转。新增出来的那个带着尖刺的齿轮并不是生物。
species.fl_en: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

species.fl: １条的电力虽小，但是许多麻麻小鱼聚在一起，其威力可以比得上雷电。
species.fl_en: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

species.fl: 圆圆的花纹是发电器官。会先缠住对手，然后把花纹压在对手身上后放出电流。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

species.fl: 用手臂的力量从海里爬出，袭击水边的猎物。在一瞬间将对方拖入海中。
species.fl_en: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

species.fl: 在大约５０年前被发现的宝可梦。会用又大又发达的大脑操纵精神力量。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

species.fl: 能控制对方的记忆。经常有人看到它在麦田的上方徘徊。
species.fl_en: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

species.fl: 吸取到的灵魂越年轻，头上的烛光就会燃烧得越旺越诡异。
species.fl_en: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

species.fl: 伪装成灯的样子藏身在城镇里。一旦发现了临近死期的人，便会悄悄地跟在后面。
species.fl_en: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

species.fl: 据说在用水晶灯火灵来充当照明设备的房子里，丧事会接连不断。
species.fl_en: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

species.fl: 会和伙伴们一起互撞牙齿来玩。折断的牙齿会马上长出来，所以丝毫都不会去在意。
species.fl_en: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

species.fl: 皮肤像盔甲一样坚硬。非常擅长在撞击的同时用牙齿猛刺的战法。
species.fl_en: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

species.fl: 性格温和，但生起气来非常恐怖。会用自己那引以为傲，可以削铁如泥的牙齿攻击敌人。
species.fl_en: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

species.fl: 使出招式前会先倒吸鼻涕。鼻涕里所含有的强烈冷气是冰属性招式的能量来源。
species.fl_en: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

species.fl: 在冰冷的大海里精力十足地游泳。感到疲劳的时候会吐出气息冻结海水，在冰面上休息。
species.fl_en: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

species.fl: 天气一热就会化为水蒸气。到了夏天几乎到处都看不到它的踪影。
species.fl_en: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

species.fl: 有着会对电能产生反应的奇异体质。不知为何，和盖盖虫待在一起就会进化。
species.fl_en: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

species.fl: 脱壳后变得更轻巧了。为了防止干燥，会将带状的粘膜裹在身上。
species.fl_en: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
species.evo: 通信交换 与盖盖虫交换

species.fl: 当从身上的黄色斑纹里释放出强大电流时，它会莫名地露出微笑。
species.fl_en: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

species.fl: 个头虽小脾气却很暴躁。面对疏忽大意接近自己的对手，会施展出华丽的连击。
species.fl_en: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

species.fl: 以迅雷不及掩耳的速度使出踢击，即使是巨大的岩石也能击得粉碎。
species.fl_en: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

species.fl: 性情凶暴而狡猾。会把其他宝可梦挖出的巢穴抢来当做自己的住处。
species.fl_en: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

species.fl: 用黏土制成的宝可梦。即使现在也一直遵循着数千年前主人的命令。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

species.fl: 虽然有人认为它体内有着生成能量的永动机，但至今仍未得到证实。
species.fl_en: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

species.fl: 以劈斩司令为首领组成族群。目标是有朝一日能统领同类，所以每天都在不懈地锻炼。
species.fl_en: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

species.fl: 为了抢占能找到磨刀石的地方，和斧牙龙展开了激烈的斗争。
species.fl_en: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

species.fl: 会以约２０只的规模群居。不知为何，背叛了族群的爆炸头水牛脑袋上的毛会脱落。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

species.fl: 握力强，能把坚硬的树果弄得粉碎。性急爱吵架，无论对谁都会挑起战斗。
species.fl_en: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

species.fl: 性格粗暴、血气方刚，因此被钢铠鸦夺走了伽勒尔运送员的地位。
species.fl_en: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

species.fl: 由于很快就会长大，屁股上的骸骨会接着传给巢里更小的秃鹰丫头用。
species.fl_en: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

species.fl: 把捡来的骨头装饰在身上。在骨头形状这方面似乎也是有流行趋势的。
species.fl_en: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

species.fl: 将火焰当成舌头来使用。会一点一点地熔化铁蚁坚硬的外骨骼，然后把它吃掉。
species.fl_en: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

species.fl: 巨大的颚部能咬碎岩石。为了不让沙螺蟒把蛋抢走，会和其他同类一起并肩战斗。
species.fl_en: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

species.fl: 因为眼睛看不见，所以会又撞又咬，来判断四周的状况。
species.fl_en: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

species.fl: ２个头会争抢同一个食物。明明没有去和别人战斗，却总是遍体鳞伤。
species.fl_en: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

species.fl: ３个头会轮流去咬敌人。在对方倒下之前，绝对不会停止攻击。
species.fl_en: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

species.fl: 全身都相当温暖。会从角的尖端喷出火焰，借此威吓天敌或猎物。
species.fl_en: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

species.fl: 从熊熊燃烧的火焰之茧中诞生。在古代的壁画上被描绘为火之神。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

species.fl: 生来就具有领导风范。即使是性格狂暴的宝可梦，在勾帕路翁面前也会变得温顺。
species.fl_en: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

species.fl: 代拉基翁为保护宝可梦而与人类作战的传说在合众地区广为流传。
species.fl_en: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

species.fl: 以敏捷的身手像旋风一般将敌人玩弄于股掌之中，会用锋利的角毫不留情地切斩对手。
species.fl_en: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

species.fl: 可引发风暴的宝可梦。传说由于它搅拌大气，季节因此得以循环不息。据本人考察，近似人类的形态才是假象而非真身。（化身形态）此乃被称为形态变化的现象。据考察，此一形同怪鸟的姿态才是其真正样貌。曾被目击以此姿态横越大海。（灵兽形态）
species.fl_en: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

species.fl: 可引发风暴的宝可梦。传说由于它搅拌大气，季节因此得以循环不息。据本人考察，近似人类的形态才是假象而非真身。（化身形态）在闪电霹雳中现身。会自尾部的连串珠子降下雷击扫荡敌手。惊人的威力足以令敌手片甲不留。（灵兽形态）
species.fl_en: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

species.fl: 在神话的叙述里，如果人类蔑视真实、放纵欲望，它就会用火焰烧尽他们的王国。
species.fl_en: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

species.fl: 在神话的描述里，如果人类失去了正义之心，它就会用狂暴的雷电毁灭他们的王国。
species.fl_en: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

species.fl: 会在旋风与电击的化身互相斗争之时现身并加以平息。在风暴与雷电过后，大地必将迎来丰收。（化身形态）以灵兽之姿翱翔天际时，会为大地带来丰收，因而受到众人崇敬。只需一刻光阴便能纵断洗翠大地。（灵兽形态）
species.fl_en: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

species.fl: 为了稳定细胞组织，它似乎用自己制造出的冷气冰冻着身体。
species.fl_en: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

species.fl: 据说当它挺过了艰难的战斗，额头上的角就能得到锻炼，从而激发出自己真正的力量。
species.fl_en: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

species.fl: 用特殊的发声法唱出的旋律可以自由地操纵听者的情绪。（歌声形态）美洛耶塔找回了被遗忘已久的歌，以魅惑的舞步令众生为之倾倒。（舞步形态）
species.fl_en: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

species.fl: 被某个组织复活的古生代的虫宝可梦。背上的大炮被改造了。装上填充了水能量的卡带的样子。会以飞行形态在空中飞翔。（水流卡带）装上填充了电能量的卡带的样子。会发射能量弹。（闪电卡带）装上填充了火能量的卡带的样子。拥有锐利的钢爪。（火焰卡带）装上填充了冰能量的卡带的样子。毫无慈悲之心。（冰冻卡带）
species.fl_en: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

species.fl: 若在头锤快命中前注入力量，就能让头上的刺变得尖锐，并贯穿敌人的身体。
species.fl_en: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

species.fl: 拥有容易亢奋的性格。体温也很容易变得过高，因此会利用耳朵放热冷静下来。
species.fl_en: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

species.fl: 会点燃尾巴上的树枝并挥动它向伙伴传递信号。遇到危险时会转动树枝画圈。
species.fl_en: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

species.fl: 会用木杖前端的火焰在地上留下烧焦的痕迹。以前的人会通过该痕迹的形状来占卜。
species.fl_en: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

species.fl: 看起来悠哉的样子其实是用来欺骗敌人的演技。会冷不防地用迅雷不及掩耳的速度压制敌人。
species.fl_en: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

species.fl: 擅长活用地形的战术。投掷被泡泡包着的小石头时百发百中。
species.fl_en: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

species.fl: 能通过卷在脖子上的长～舌头所接触到的空气流动来察觉看不见身影的敌人的动静。
species.fl_en: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

species.fl: 对危险很敏感。只要听到钢铠鸦拍打翅膀的声音，就会马上挖洞钻进地下藏身。
species.fl_en: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

species.fl: 肚子上的体毛保温性能优秀。在过去，人们会用它的落毛来制作保暖服装。
species.fl_en: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

species.fl: 一旦兴奋体温就会急剧上升。赤手去摸甚至有可能会被灼伤。
species.fl_en: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

species.fl: 领地意识很强，性格好战。火箭雀彼此之间会为了觅食的地方发生争斗。
species.fl_en: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

species.fl: 会以５００公里的时速进行突击。不给猎物留下逃跑的机会，直接以猛烈的踢击将其解决。
species.fl_en: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

species.fl: 吸入体内的毒素会变成黑色的粉末被排出体外，所以它可以吃毒叶和毒树根。
species.fl_en: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

species.fl: 被毛头小鹰的鸟嘴袭击时，就会靠尖锐的体毛和带毒的黑色粉末来迎战。
species.fl_en: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

species.fl: 身上的花纹会受到诞生地的气候和风土影响而改变。这是它在极为寒冷的地方的样子。（冰雪花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在降雪量多的地方能见到这种样子。（雪国花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在气候严寒的地方能见到这种样子。（雪原花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在辽阔的地方能见到这种样子。（大陆花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在绿意盎然的地方能见到这种样子。（庭园花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在四季分明的地方能见到这种样子。（高雅花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在花朵盛开的地方能见到这种样子。（花园花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在日照强烈的地方能见到这种样子。（摩登花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在海风吹拂的地方能见到这种样子。（大海花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在岛屿群集的地方能见到这种样子。（群岛花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在少雨的地方能见到这种样子。（荒野花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在极为干旱的地方能见到这种样子。（沙尘花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在大河流淌的地方能见到这种样子。（大河花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在雨势激烈的地方能见到这种样子。（骤雨花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在热带气候的地方能见到这种样子。（热带草原花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在光线充足的地方能见到这种样子。（太阳花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在四季如夏的地方能见到这种样子。（大洋花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在热带雨林的地方能见到这种样子。（热带雨林花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在神奇的地方能见到这种样子。（幻彩花纹）身上的花纹会受到出生地的气候和风土的影响而改变。在特别的地方能见到这种样子。（球球花纹）
species.fl_en: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

species.fl: 血气方刚且好奇心旺盛。如果生气或是开始战斗，短短的鬃毛就会变热。
species.fl_en: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

species.fl: 会吐出摄氏６０００度的气息，但不会用于猎物。因为更喜欢吃生的肉。
species.fl_en: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

species.fl: 头上的冠是收集花粉做成的。蕴藏着治愈的效果。
species.fl_en: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

species.fl: 把自己的力量给花，用心地照料。绝不原谅那些破坏花坛者。
species.fl_en: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

species.fl: 拥有几百年的寿命。据说会终其一生不断地守护着庭园。
species.fl_en: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

species.fl: 直到最近为止都还有山岳的居民乘坐在坐骑小羊的背上，在山路上移动。
species.fl_en: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

species.fl: 用角一碰就可以感受到对方的心情。从５０００年前起就一直协助着人类工作至今。
species.fl_en: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

species.fl: 为了不被小看而一直瞪着对手，然而绷紧的神经一旦稍有放松，它就会在无意中露出笑脸。
species.fl_en: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

species.fl: 通过叶子来洞悉敌人的动向。只要使出一记拳击就能让大型翻斗车变成废铁。
species.fl_en: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
species.evo_en: Lv.32, with a Dark-type in party

species.fl: 如果置之不理，体毛会不断地长长，但只允许信赖的人修剪。
species.fl_en: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

species.fl: 虽然拥有可以弹飞职业摔角手的精神力量，却因无法好好控制而感到烦恼。
species.fl_en: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

species.fl: 雄性的防卫本能很强，在保护自己和伙伴时能发挥最大的威力。
species.fl_en: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

species.fl: 独剑鞘剑格上的蓝色眼珠是它的本体。会用陈旧的布吸取人类的精气。
species.fl_en: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

species.fl: ２把剑会用令人眼花缭乱的速度不断交替攻击和防御，借以制服猎物。
species.fl_en: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

species.fl: 坚盾剑怪曾经用强大的灵力控制人和宝可梦，建立了适合自己生活的国家。
species.fl_en: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

species.fl: 身上飘出的香气能让人们神魂颠倒。贵妇们对它钟爱万分。
species.fl_en: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

species.fl: 会发出恶臭让敌人丧失战意，或者发出芳香的味道来帮助自己的伙伴。
species.fl_en: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带香袋

species.fl: 蓬松的体毛闻起来就像棉花糖一样甜甜的。会放出黏糊糊的丝缠住敌人。
species.fl_en: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

species.fl: 因为体毛里富含空气，所以摸起来十分柔软，重量也比看起来要轻。
species.fl_en: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.
species.evo: 通信交换 携带泡沫奶油

species.fl: 会让敌人看到自己闪烁的发光体来让对方丧失战意，然后趁机逃之夭夭。
species.fl_en: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

species.fl: 据说那些能够改变历史的重大事件其实都和乌贼王的催眠能力有关。
species.fl_en: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

species.fl: 如果２只龟脚脚配合得不好，不但无法有效地攻击和防御，甚至没办法生存下去。
species.fl_en: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

species.fl: 用手掌上的眼珠来观察前后左右的状况。遇上危机时手脚会自己动起来打倒对手。
species.fl_en: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

species.fl: 看上去很像腐烂的海藻，因此会藏身于漂在海里的碎藻中，骗过敌人的眼睛。
species.fl_en: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

species.fl: 会通过将头上的伞状部分伸出海面吸收阳光的方式，在体内制造龙之能量。
species.fl_en: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

species.fl: 通过引爆积蓄在右臂钳子中的气体，像发射子弹般将水喷射出去，击倒敌人。
species.fl_en: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

species.fl: 右臂是能够喷射海水炮弹的大炮。威力大到足以击沉油轮。
species.fl_en: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

species.fl: 拥有太阳能发电的结构。如果有人打扰它发电，它就会因心理压力而衰弱。
species.fl_en: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

species.fl: 如果展开颈伞沐浴阳光，单凭１只光电伞蜥就能制造出大城市所需的电力。
species.fl_en: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

species.fl: 又任性又爱撒娇。即使它只是闹着玩，也会让训练家受重伤。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

species.fl: 如果被它的大颚咬到，连汽车都会变得粉碎。是古代世界的王者。
species.fl_en: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

species.fl: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。有时候它还会以冰封的状态被发现喔。
species.fl_en: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

species.fl: 当它被激怒时，就会喷出猛烈的冷气，把周围都冰封起来。
species.fl_en: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

species.fl: 伽勒尔地区的童话中有着美丽的仙子伊布击退了可怕的龙宝可梦的故事。
species.fl_en: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
species.evo: 亲密度高 学会妖精属性招式
species.evo_en: high friendship, knowing a Fairy-type move

species.fl: 在使出致命的绝招之前一定要先摆出华丽的姿势。有时也会在这一刻遭到反击。
species.fl_en: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

species.fl: 由于发电的能力弱，会从插座或其他的电气宝可梦那里偷电。
species.fl_en: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

species.fl: 据说在世界上的某处，有个沉睡着许多小碎钻的矿脉，它们的女王也在那里。
species.fl_en: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

species.fl: 它的触角是优秀的感觉器官。只要感觉到有敌人就会立刻藏起来，以此存活到了现在。
species.fl_en: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

species.fl: 背上的突起物里装着它小小的脑子，里面只想着吃饭和逃离敌人这两件事。
species.fl_en: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

species.fl: 用伸长角产生的力道来攻击对手，产生的威力比重量级拳击手的拳击还强１００倍。
species.fl_en: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

species.fl: 会用头的前端吸取金属离子。之所以长得像钥匙，据说是因为太过喜欢钥匙，情不自禁进行了模仿。
species.fl_en: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

species.fl: 用类似人类小孩的声音鸣叫，把大人引到森林的深处，让他们在其中迷失方向。
species.fl_en: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

species.fl: 脚尖伸出来的根须能连结森林中的树木，并且自由自在地加以操纵。
species.fl_en: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

species.fl: 南瓜的洞里发出的光会催眠并控制看到它的人和宝可梦。
species.fl_en: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

species.fl: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里去别人家门口敲门。开了门的人会被它带往另一个世界。
species.fl_en: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

species.fl: 栖息在极其寒冷的地域。会把自己的脚冻在冰岩怪的背上固定起来。
species.fl_en: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

species.fl: 虽然身体的裂缝会因白天的活动而变大，但只要一晚就能全部长好。
species.fl_en: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

species.fl: 可以控制所有频率的音波。就算是体型巨大的宝可梦，也对它的超音波束手无策。
species.fl_en: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

species.fl: 在黑暗中一边飞行一边发出能粉碎岩石的超音波痛击敌人，然后用利齿给予致命的一击。
species.fl_en: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

species.fl: 据说，当头上的角闪着七色光时，会分享永恒的生命。
species.fl_en: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

species.fl: 听说，寿命终结时，会吸光所有生物的生命，返回到茧的样子。
species.fl_en: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

species.fl: 据说，在与威胁到生态系统者战斗时，它会变化为更强大的样子。
species.fl_en: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

species.fl: 小碎钻的突变体。闪着粉红色光辉的身体被赞为全世界最美。额头上光辉夺目的钻石竟然有２０００克拉重。别名皇家粉色公主。（超级进化）
species.fl_en: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

species.fl: 会使用圆环把自己喜欢的东西收集到秘密的住所中。会钻入环里瞬间移动。（惩戒胡帕）将被封印的力量找回来后的本来面目。据说胸上的洞与异次元相连。（解放胡帕）
species.fl_en: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

species.fl: 从背上的手臂里喷射出体内的水蒸气。有着把整座山一下子吹飞的威力。
species.fl_en: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

species.fl: 白天利用光合作用积蓄力量，到了晚上则会悄无声息地在空中飞翔，寻找猎物。
species.fl_en: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

species.fl: 对整理翅膀丝毫不会怠慢。这不单是因为它注重形象，也是为了让刃羽保持锐利。
species.fl_en: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

species.fl: 只要０.１秒就可以在翅膀的藤蔓上搭好箭羽、射向敌人，并在敌人发现前贯穿其要害。
species.fl_en: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

species.fl: 如果在得到火斑喵的信任前就想抚摸它的话，要小心它用尖锐的爪子抓你。
species.fl_en: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

species.fl: 如果敌人实力强劲，它便会更有战斗的欲望，火焰铃铛的火力也会随之上升。
species.fl_en: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

species.fl: 虽然行为举止十分粗野，却也有着会去帮助弱小宝可梦的温柔一面。
species.fl_en: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

species.fl: 每天拼命地练习，才终于能够制造出又大又好用的气球。
species.fl_en: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

species.fl: 到了风平浪静的夜晚，会配合领队西狮海壬的歌声和伙伴们一起跳舞。
species.fl_en: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

species.fl: 对战就是西狮海壬的舞台。它那歌声和舞动气球的样子使观战的人们为之倾倒。
species.fl_en: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

species.fl: 拥有看着很细，却很强韧的颈部肌肉。能以每秒１６连击的速度猛啄树木。
species.fl_en: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

species.fl: 会将吃掉的树果种子从口中射出。种子散落在大地上，新的草木便会生长出来。
species.fl_en: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

species.fl: 因成双成对感情和睦而闻名。它被视为一种吉祥的象征，常被带到结婚仪式去。
species.fl_en: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

species.fl: 什么都吃，但喜欢吃新鲜的活物。所以会为了寻找猎物在路上四处游走。
species.fl_en: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

species.fl: 忍耐力非常强，但如果见到它爱吃的小拉达，就会忘乎所以地扑过去。
species.fl_en: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

species.fl: 会用巨大的颚部在森林中挖地制造巢穴。最喜欢甜甜的树汁。
species.fl_en: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

species.fl: 虫电宝消化吃掉的落叶时会产生电能。它会把这些电能储存在自己肚子上的电囊中。
species.fl_en: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

species.fl: 如果它在飞翔时把虫电宝抱住当作备用电池，就能连续发射电力超高的电磁光束。
species.fl_en: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

species.fl: 有时会把椰蛋树错认为椰子树而爬上去。惹怒椰蛋树后被抖落下来，并遭到踩踏。
species.fl_en: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

species.fl: 比起思考，会先试着打打看。曾经有过用拳头猛攻打退雪崩的记录。
species.fl_en: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

species.fl: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的花舞鸟。训练家弄错指示的话就会非常生气。是情感变化非常剧烈的家伙。
species.fl_en: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

species.fl: 从敌人散发出的气场来判断对方下一步的行动。能轻盈地躲开攻击并进行反击。
species.fl_en: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

species.fl: 最讨厌雨水弄湿自己。因为伽勒尔地区阴天居多，所以很难见得到它的身影。
species.fl_en: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

species.fl: 将脖子上的岩石向地面发射，以此威吓对手。在对方畏缩的刹那发起袭击。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

species.fl: 会用敏捷的动作将猎物一点一点逼入绝境。利齿总是瞄准着对方的要害。
species.fl_en: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

species.fl: 感觉到危险时眼睛就会变得湿润。眼泪的光亮会成为召集伙伴的信号，让许多的弱丁鱼聚在一起。
species.fl_en: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

species.fl: 和阿罗拉的好坏星不同，伽勒尔的好坏星还没发现到太阳珊瑚的枝有多好吃。
species.fl_en: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

species.fl: 体内的毒囊中储存着满满的剧毒，毒性强到能让吼鲸王都痛苦三天三夜。
species.fl_en: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

species.fl: 在把自己吃土制造出的泥巴涂在脚上之后，无论走在路况多么差的路上都不会打滑。
species.fl_en: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

species.fl: 拥有很强的耐力，可以不眠不休地拉着１０吨重的货物纵贯伽勒尔地区。
species.fl_en: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

species.fl: 平时生活在水中，也会戴上水泡去陆地上寻找食物。
species.fl_en: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

species.fl: 把滴蛛放进头上的水泡里，一边喂它吃剩的食物，一边照顾它。
species.fl_en: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

species.fl: 白天沐浴阳光，呼呼大睡。到了半夜才醒来并开始活动。
species.fl_en: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

species.fl: 双臂的花瓣既薄又锋利。还能够积蓄阳光发射光束。
species.fl_en: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

species.fl: 白天也生活在昏暗的森林里。会一边闪烁一边散播发光的孢子来让敌人陷入沉睡。
species.fl_en: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

species.fl: 如果大半夜在森林的深处看见光亮，记住千万不要接近。灯罩夜菇会让你睡着的。
species.fl_en: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

species.fl: 悄悄地从背后靠近猎物，在对方察觉之前释放毒气，让对方动弹不得。
species.fl_en: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

species.fl: 据说焰后蜥之间在争斗时，是通过比拼谁带着更多只雄性夜盗火蜥来定胜负的。
species.fl_en: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

species.fl: 为了保护自己的身体而胡乱挥舞前脚的样子虽然可爱，威力却大到能将大树折断。
species.fl_en: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

species.fl: 会用令格斗家都无地自容的技术把逮住的猎物夹在腋下，带回自己的住处。
species.fl_en: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

species.fl: 受到袭击时流下的汗水非常甜美可口。那种香气会吸引更多敌人的注意。
species.fl_en: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

species.fl: 会用头部的壳盖击打飞来啄食自己的蓝鸦，并且对它使出猛烈的踢击。
species.fl_en: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

species.fl: 用又尖又硬的脚尖施展脚踢，朝对手的身体和心灵留下无法磨灭的创伤。
species.fl_en: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

species.fl: 散发着迷人香气的宝可梦。由于每只花疗环环身上的花都不一样，所以香味也各不相同。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

species.fl: 对森林的各个角落都了如指掌。如果有宝可梦受伤了，就会去寻找药草为它们治疗。
species.fl_en: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

species.fl: ２０几只形成团队来生活。靠着每个成员明确的分工，在严苛的大自然中生存下来。
species.fl_en: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

species.fl: 成群聚集，随时提高警惕。只要察觉到有敌人，就会分散开来四处逃窜。
species.fl_en: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

species.fl: 生活在海底的洞窟或沉船里。会去和八爪武师决战，输掉的一方便会成为对方的食物。
species.fl_en: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

species.fl: 主要栖息在沙滩上。操纵把手伸进自己嘴里的对手，从而让自己变得更大。
species.fl_en: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

species.fl: 虽然住在沙滩上，但是讨厌水。要是淋了大雨，就无法维持城堡的造型。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

species.fl: 覆盖着皮肤的粘液具有出众的保湿效果，即使在陆地上待好几天也不会干掉。
species.fl_en: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

species.fl: 以神话中的宝可梦为原型所创造出的宝可梦，被戴上了抑制力量失控的面罩。
species.fl_en: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

species.fl: 与所信赖的训练家之间的牵绊是解放它真正力量的最后一个要素。
species.fl_en: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

species.fl: 外壳非常坚固，但落到地上的冲击会让它碎成细屑。
species.fl_en: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

species.fl: 到死都一直是睡着的状态，是因为吃的叶子里含有类似麻醉药的成分。
species.fl_en: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

species.fl: 在火山上生活，吃下的硫磺就是甲壳上炸药的原料。连粪便也会爆炸，十分危险。
species.fl_en: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

species.fl: 在危急时刻会把身体卷成一团，倒竖起背上的尖刺，不分青红皂白地发出电击。
species.fl_en: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

species.fl: 有一位学者为了研究而看了它的破布里面，结果患上怪病而离开人世。
species.fl_en: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

species.fl: 厚实的皮肤连好坏星的针也穿不透。会用结实的牙齿嘎嘣嘎嘣地咬碎针吃下去。
species.fl_en: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

species.fl: 心地善良爱亲近人，但只要生气就会刮起强风吹倒一切。
species.fl_en: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

species.fl: 把锚抛到海里，伏击猎物。会去捕捉巨大的吼鲸王，吸取它们的精气。
species.fl_en: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

species.fl: 体毛变成了像金属一般坚硬的鳞片。通过敲击鳞片来和伙伴交流。
species.fl_en: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

species.fl: 敲响鳞片，发出吼声，接着向对手发起挑战，并用锋利的爪子撕裂对手。
species.fl_en: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

species.fl: 遗迹壁画中古代战士身上穿着的盔甲是用杖尾鳞甲龙的鳞片制成的。
species.fl_en: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

species.fl: 操纵雷的美乐美乐的守护神。好奇心旺盛，会时不时在人们面前现身。
species.fl_en: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

species.fl: 被称为守护神，却兼有天真无邪与残酷的性格，被誉为自然的化身。
species.fl_en: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

species.fl: 会鸣响尾巴，告知自己的居所，以避免不必要的战争。是操纵草木的乌拉乌拉的守护神。
species.fl_en: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

species.fl: 被称为守护神，但有时会给随便靠近的对方带去恐怖的灾难。
species.fl_en: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

species.fl: 没有警戒心且好奇心强，所以经常会遇到麻烦。危急时会用瞬间移动来逃跑。
species.fl_en: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

species.fl: 以惊人的气势吸入大气中的尘埃，努力用内核制造着进化的能源。
species.fl_en: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

species.fl: 曾经被称为吞食太阳之兽。能释放出无尽的光能。
species.fl_en: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

species.fl: 夺走四周所有的光，自己则变身为满月的模样，在黑夜中散发出光芒。
species.fl_en: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

species.fl: 从究极之洞出现，来到这个世界。好像会寄生在宝可梦或人类的身上生存下去。
species.fl_en: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

species.fl: 会炫耀膨胀到异常程度的肌肉。是究极异兽中的一种。
species.fl_en: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

species.fl: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。
species.fl_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.fl: 被称为究极异兽。也有像树木一样将手脚插入地面后一动不动的。
species.fl_en: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

species.fl: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。
species.fl_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.fl: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。
species.fl_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.fl: 被称为究极异兽的未知生命。不知是不是经常觉得肚子饿，一直都在吃着什么东西。
species.fl_en: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

species.fl: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。会发射出激光，将所有东西切成碎片。
