species.fl_en: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

species.fl: 大约５００年前由科学家制作而成。被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。
species.fl_en: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

species.fl: 拥有潜入一切影子里的能力，所以在很长一段时间里都没有任何人发现它。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

species.fl: 栖息在异世界的究极异兽。会从头部的毒针朝对手喷出毒液，咯咯咯大笑。
species.fl_en: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

species.fl: 究极异兽中的一种。会从毒针发射出黏性很大又发光的毒液。
species.fl_en: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

species.fl: 像是究极异兽的谜一般的生命体。突然动起来并展开袭击的石墙，正身就是这家伙。
species.fl_en: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

species.fl: 从究极之洞里出现的究极异兽。用爆炸吓唬对手，趁那空当夺走对方的生命气息。
species.fl_en: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

species.fl: 从手脚的肉球放电。当捷拉奥拉奔驰而过时，周围将充斥着电闪雷鸣，
species.fl_en: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

species.fl: 美录坦们虽然聚在一起生活，但当时机到来，会由最强的那１只吸收其他的伙伴来进化。
species.fl_en: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

species.fl: 美录梅塔利用离心力带动沉重的螺帽挥出的拳击被认为是宝可梦界之最。
species.fl_en: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

species.fl: 会用木棒连续击打来攻击。在以飞快的速度击打的同时，情绪也会变得越来越高涨。
species.fl_en: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

species.fl: 打着激烈的节拍战斗时，由于过于忘我，甚至不会意识到自己已经把对手打昏了。
species.fl_en: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

species.fl: 打鼓技巧最高超的那一只会成为首领。性情温和，重视族群的和谐相处。
species.fl_en: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

species.fl: 一旦做好了战斗的准备，它鼻头上和脚底的肉球就会发出极度的高温。
species.fl_en: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

species.fl: 会用脚把树果从树木上踢落，用来练习颠球，借此锻炼自己的脚法。
species.fl_en: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

species.fl: 拥有熟练的进攻和防守技巧。只要得到声援就会更有冲劲，但有时会为了出风头而弄巧成拙。
species.fl_en: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

species.fl: 皮肤在湿掉时会变色，仿佛像是隐身了一样，谁都看不见它的身影。
species.fl_en: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

species.fl: 头脑聪明但是怕麻烦。为了不让敌人接近自己的地盘，在各个地方都设下了陷阱。
species.fl_en: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

species.fl: 能从指尖射出速度高达３马赫的水枪。它的瞬膜能帮助它看穿敌人的弱点，准确地击中要害。
species.fl_en: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

species.fl: 由于它无论何时都在吃树果，使得它比外表看起来还要顽强。会出现在田地里寻找树果。
species.fl_en: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

species.fl: 无论多么坚硬的树果壳都能用引以为傲的大牙咬碎。在伽勒尔是很常见的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

species.fl: 娇小的体型让它能敏捷地飞翔。利用攻其不备的战法将体型巨大的对手玩弄于股掌之间。
species.fl_en: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

species.fl: 经历无数次艰难的战斗后，它学会了该如何正确地判断敌人的力量。
species.fl_en: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

species.fl: 拥有优秀飞行能力和极度聪明头脑的它在伽勒尔地区从事飞翔出租车的工作。
species.fl_en: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

species.fl: 经常出现在田地里的宝可梦。会通过长在身体上的毛来感应周围发生的事。
species.fl_en: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

species.fl: 正在壳里成长着。用精神力量掌握外界的状况，做好进化的准备。
species.fl_en: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

species.fl: 释放出精神力量来调查周围的情况。它的侦测范围甚至可以达到方圆１０公里。
species.fl_en: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

species.fl: 性格谨慎且狡猾。在偷盗食物逃走的时候会用尾巴擦掉自己的足迹。
species.fl_en: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

species.fl: 靠着轻盈的身体和锐利的爪子到处去偷食物和蛋。逐电犬是它的天敌。
species.fl_en: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

species.fl: 会随着微风一边转圈圈一边愉快地唱歌。许多人因为喜欢这可爱的模样而培育它。
species.fl_en: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

species.fl: 用它头上的棉絮制成的线有着十分美丽动人的光泽，是伽勒尔地区的名产。
species.fl_en: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

species.fl: 要是身上的毛长得太长就会不能动弹。用毛辫羊的体毛织成的布结实得让人吃惊。
species.fl_en: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

species.fl: 长得长长的角是为了向异性求爱而存在的。它从不会把角当做武器。
species.fl_en: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

species.fl: 会用头上硬如岩石的角攻击敌人。趁其不备之时大口咬住对方，一旦咬住便再也不会松口。
species.fl_en: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

species.fl: 颈部可以伸缩。能从远处迅速伸长颈部，用锐利的牙齿解决对手。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

species.fl: 因为想要得到零食而帮助人类工作的贪吃鬼。总是带着电火花跑来跑去。
species.fl_en: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

species.fl: 电力增强了它的脚力。当以最高速度奔跑时，时速可以轻易超过９０公里。
species.fl_en: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

species.fl: 在满是岩石的崎岖之路上也能像独轮车那样自在移动。靠燃烧煤炭维持生命。
species.fl_en: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

species.fl: 能通过高速旋转自己的脚，以３０公里的时速奔跑。能喷出１０００度的火焰。
species.fl_en: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 进入战斗状态后，它会把煤炭山燃烧得通红，飞撒火花来烧焦四周。
species.fl_en: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

species.fl: 一出生就躲进了苹果中。一边吃果肉一边成长。进化方向因苹果的味道而定。
species.fl_en: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

species.fl: 会用苹果皮的翅膀飞翔，并吐出强酸性的唾液。可以变成苹果的形状。
species.fl_en: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

species.fl: 身体被甜甜的蜜汁包裹，背部的皮尤其甘甜，过去曾经是小孩的零食。
species.fl_en: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

species.fl: 会从鼻孔喷射出沙子，趁敌人看不清的时候躲进地底下藏身。
species.fl_en: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

species.fl: 它之所以会以独特的方式盘绕自己的身体，是为了能更高效地喷射砂囊中的沙子。
species.fl_en: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

species.fl: 非常贪吃，会把刺梭鱼整只吞进嘴里。偶尔也会搞错对象去咬其他的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

species.fl: 吃饱了之后动作会变得极度迟缓，于是就被古月鸟整只吞了下去。
species.fl_en: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

species.fl: 会旋转着自己的尾鳍一口气突击。能够以超过１００节的速度贯穿猎物。
species.fl_en: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

species.fl: 通过让自身的毒素产生化学反应来发电。电力虽然弱，却能造成麻痹。
species.fl_en: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

species.fl: 气势汹汹的急性子。会大口喝下浑浊的水，吸收其中所含的毒素。
species.fl_en: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

species.fl: 会用滚烫的身体勒紧猎物，等到烤得恰到好处之时，就把它们大口大口地吃掉。
species.fl_en: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

species.fl: 性格极具攻击性。危险的不只是它烧烫的身体，大大的獠牙也锐利无比。
species.fl_en: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

species.fl: 智商大致相当于３岁的儿童。虽然触手经常断掉，但因为能再生，所以它并不在意。
species.fl_en: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

species.fl: 会为了试自己的身手而登上陆地寻找对手。战斗结束后就会回到海里。
species.fl_en: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

species.fl: 被它当成住处的茶杯是有名的古董餐具。市面上有很多赝品。
species.fl_en: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

species.fl: 每当发现喝剩的红茶，它就会把自己的身体倒进去，让那壶红茶变成怖思壶。
species.fl_en: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

species.fl: 喜欢没有人烟的地方。一旦感觉到强烈的感情，就会一溜烟地逃走。
species.fl_en: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

species.fl: 会用头上的辫子攻击对手，让对方安静下来。破坏力强到能一击ＫＯ职业拳击手。
species.fl_en: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

species.fl: 又被称为森林魔女。如果有人大吵大闹，可能会被它用触手上的爪子撕碎。
species.fl_en: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

species.fl: 不但会溜进民宅偷盗，还会吸收人们悔恨时的负面能量。
species.fl_en: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

species.fl: 喜欢动歪脑筋，把人们引诱到深夜的森林中。似乎拥有培育农作物的能力。
species.fl_en: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

species.fl: 毛发能发挥肌肉纤维般的作用。伸展开来时会像触手那样把对手缠绕起来。
species.fl_en: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

species.fl: 在不断的斗争中得到了进化。它交叉着双臂发出的怒吼能让一切对手都为之胆怯。
species.fl_en: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

species.fl: 在日复一日的战斗中得以进化。进化的结果是那危险的指甲，留长后能当作短剑来用。
species.fl_en: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

species.fl: 一定要小心它那包覆着灵魂的灵体。如果触摸到，就会像石头一样动弹不得。
species.fl_en: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

species.fl: 会用坚硬的葱叶抵挡攻击，接着用锋利的茎反击。它的葱既是武器也是食材。
species.fl_en: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

species.fl: 幽默的动作使它获得了众人的喜爱。能从腹部的图案释放出精神力量。
species.fl_en: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

species.fl: 绝对不能触摸它影子般的身体，否则它会让你看到印刻在它画中的恐怖记忆。
species.fl_en: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

species.fl: 据说有小仙奶现身过的蛋糕店保证能生意兴隆。
species.fl_en: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

species.fl: 当它感到幸福的时候，手中产生出的鲜奶油会变得更加香浓甜美。
species.fl_en: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

species.fl: ６只为一体的宝可梦。惯于团队行动，会一边变换阵形一边战斗。
species.fl_en: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

species.fl: 每根刺里都储存着电力。即使是折断的刺也至少能连续放电３小时。
species.fl_en: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

species.fl: 会吃地面上的积雪。吃得越多，背上的刺就会长得越挺拔。
species.fl_en: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

species.fl: 绝不放过破坏山野环境的人。会用冰冷的翅膀四处飞翔，制造出暴风雪来惩罚他们。
species.fl_en: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

species.fl: 每年会有一天，它们会在特定的时间突然出现，聚集在一起排成一个圈。
species.fl_en: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

species.fl: 无论何时都用冰块冰镇着自己怕热的脸。会把头顶上的毛垂到海里钓食物吃。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

species.fl: 能通过自己的角去感受附近生物的情感。正面情绪是它的能量之源。
species.fl_en: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

species.fl: 无论怎么吃都会马上肚子饿。十分珍爱自己用电烘烤过的种子，随时都带在身上。
species.fl_en: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

species.fl: 擅长需要力气的工作。铜质的身体会因雨水而生锈，转变成鲜艳的绿色。
species.fl_en: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

species.fl: 群居的宝可梦。鼻子的握力十分强劲，甚至能把大石头弄得粉碎。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

species.fl: 会用尾部结实的肌肉发电。与下半身相比，上半身真的太小了。
species.fl_en: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

species.fl: 曾经生活在古代的海边，能用身体的冰来保存食物，但由于动作太迟缓而灭绝了。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

species.fl: 虽然能用自豪的脚力以６０公里的时速奔跑，但是只能在水中呼吸。
species.fl_en: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

species.fl: 面部的皮肤无论受到什么攻击都不会受伤，但由于呼吸起来不方便而灭绝了。
species.fl_en: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

species.fl: 由特殊金属构成的身体十分轻盈，能够灵活地活动。不喜欢下雨，所以住在洞窟里。
species.fl_en: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

species.fl: 虽然单独１只弱得甚至敌不过小孩，但会和伙伴合作一起锻炼，通过进化而变得更强。
species.fl_en: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

species.fl: 要是没让自己在照顾的多龙梅西亚乘在头上就静不下心来，甚至会因此试图把别的宝可梦放到头上。
species.fl_en: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

species.fl: 它角里的多龙梅西亚似乎满心期待着能被以音速发射出去。
species.fl_en: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

species.fl: 这只宝可梦被认为是沉睡已久的藏玛然特的姐姐，也有人认为它们之间是劲敌关系。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

species.fl: 以石像般的姿态陷入长久沉眠的宝可梦。几乎就要被人们所遗忘。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

species.fl: 来自于２万年前坠落到地上的陨石之中。似乎与极巨化之谜有所关联。
species.fl_en: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

species.fl: 拉紧头上又白又长的体毛，就会变得斗气势高昂，并从丹田涌出力量。
species.fl_en: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

species.fl: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。
species.fl_en: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

species.fl: 长在身上的藤蔓断掉之后会变成土壤的养分，帮助森林中的植物成长。
species.fl_en: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

species.fl: 整个身体是制造电能的器官。可以制造出伽勒尔全域所需的电力。
species.fl_en: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

species.fl: 整个身体是龙之能量的结晶。据说它拥有所有龙宝可梦的能力。
species.fl_en: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

species.fl: 拥有十分惊人的怪力。戴在脸上的冰之面罩硬度是钻石的１００倍
species.fl_en: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

species.fl: 在黑暗的夜晚中奔跑，吸取正在睡觉的生物的生命能量。喜欢孤独和静寂。
species.fl_en: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

species.fl: 曾经在很久以前统治着伽勒尔的传说之王。拥有治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。
species.fl_en: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

species.fl: 制造肉眼不可见的障壁时，黑珠会发出妖异的光辉。从它身上脱落的胡须是用来制作温暖冬衣的实用原料。
species.fl_en: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

species.fl: 在火山地带能以极低概率发现的矿石让它实现了部分身体变为岩石的进化。
species.fl_en: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

species.fl: 在飘洋过海所到达的土地上存活下来的结果，让它的样子和能力起了特别的变化。（赫月）
species.fl_en: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

species.fl: 在前往出生的河川的艰苦旅程中丧命的伙伴的灵魂时刻缠绕在它的身上。（雄性的样子）缠绕在身上的伙伴们的灵魂化为了推进力，能若无其事地在激流中游泳。（雌性的样子）
species.fl_en: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

species.fl: 拥有凌驾其他物种之上的身体能力以及剧毒。在寒冷的高地上所向无敌。偏好独自行动，而不会集结成群。
species.fl_en: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
species.evo: 携带锐利之爪 白天

species.fl: 即使在睡着的时候，只要有会动的东西接近，毒针就会无意识地作出反应刺过去。
species.fl_en: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

species.fl: 当它越过大海飞来，便代表严寒的冬季即将终结。传说中其慈爱将使新的生命在洗翠大地上萌芽。（化身形态）自女人的姿态变化而成。若有谁做出糟蹋生命之事，便会从云海中现身，愤怒地降下无情的惩罚。（灵兽形态）
species.fl_en: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

species.fl: 毛茸茸的体毛有着近似于植物的成分。会勤于洗脸以防止干燥。
species.fl_en: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

species.fl: 灵巧地操控长长的体毛下隐藏着的藤蔓，接着把坚硬的花苞甩向敌人。
species.fl_en: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

species.fl: 花看似浮在空中，其实它是通过斗篷内的毛的反射来隐藏住了茎。
species.fl_en: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

species.fl: 会躺在温暖的岩石上，利用四边形的鳞片吸收的热量来制造火之能量。
species.fl_en: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

species.fl: 由于火之能量与过剩的生命力相互结合，使它头上出现了蛋状的火球。
species.fl_en: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

species.fl: 能以歌声改变外形的火鸟，据说是由灵魂寄宿在头上的火球所形成的。
species.fl_en: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.fl: 很久以前从远方的土地来到这里栖息。羽毛分泌出的凝胶有防水和防污的效果。
species.fl_en: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

species.fl: 通过在浅滩持续奔跑来锻炼腰腿，借此与伙伴比拼谁的腿技更为华丽。
species.fl_en: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

species.fl: 活用只要一脚就能踢翻卡车的强韧脚力，展现充满异国风情的舞蹈。
species.fl_en: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

species.fl: 一整天都在觅食。明明拥有优秀的嗅觉，却只用来寻找食物。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

species.fl: 以自己细致透亮的肌肤为傲。会从尾巴的前端释放出凝缩的香气。（雄性的样子）会释放出如花般的香气。肌肉发达的腿可以轻而易举地跳过５米高。（雌性的样子）
species.fl_en: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

species.fl: 包裹着身体的丝线团具有十足的弹力，能把天敌飞天螳螂的镰刀反弹回去。
species.fl_en: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

species.fl: 用丝线吸附在树枝或天花板上无声无息地行动。会在自己被发现之前将猎物打倒。
species.fl_en: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

species.fl: 总是将第３双脚折起来。拥有陷入危机时能够跳跃１０米以上的脚力。
species.fl_en: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

species.fl: 认真起来时会靠折起的脚站起来进入决战模式。会在短时间内压制敌人。
species.fl_en: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

species.fl: 脸颊上的电囊尚未发达。必须拼命摩擦前脚的肉球才得以制造出电力。
species.fl_en: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

species.fl: 当群体受到袭击的时候，会率先挑起战斗，并活用电击的格斗招式打倒敌人。
species.fl_en: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

species.fl: 虽然平时动作慢吞吞的，但在不得不面对战斗时，会以迅雷不及掩耳的身手击溃敌人。
species.fl_en: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

species.fl: 凭借默契十足的团队合作，用门牙切断能当作巢穴的材料的东西，并将其搬走。
species.fl_en: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

species.fl: 会制造巨大的巢穴，并根据用途来分出多个房间，包含寝室、餐厅等等。（三只家庭）不知不觉之间多了２只小孩。它们看起来像是一家子，但真相如何没人知道。（四只家庭）
species.fl_en: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

species.fl: 摸起来既湿润又光滑。吐息中包含的酵母可以让周围的东西发酵。
species.fl_en: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

species.fl: 身体散发出的迷人香气有助于小麦的成长，因此在农村一直备受重视。
species.fl_en: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

species.fl: 从头上的果实喷出油，以此保护自己不受敌人攻击。那种油苦涩到能让人跳起来。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

species.fl: 乐于分享自己香气新鲜又美味可口的油。自古以来直至今日都与人类共存。
species.fl_en: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

species.fl: 性情温和，慈悲为怀。会把营养丰富且美味可口的油分享给虚弱的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

species.fl: 喜欢栖息在街道上。会以羽毛的颜色来组队，然后展开领地之争。（绿羽毛）庞大的队里成员能超过５０只。觅食时会在街上或森林里吵吵闹闹地四处盘旋。（蓝羽毛）性情和战斗方式都很粗暴。会冲进对手的怀里，用自己的肉身发动攻击。（黄羽毛）不擅长单独行动。凝聚力很强，靠着与伙伴互相合作而生存了下来。（白羽毛）
species.fl_en: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.fl: 出生在地底的岩盐层。原意分享贵重的盐巴，因此在过去非常受到重视。
species.fl_en: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

species.fl: 朝着猎物喷出盐，并将其做成盐腌物。猎物体内的水分会在此过程中被夺走。
species.fl_en: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

species.fl: 只要它摩擦指尖，搓出盐来撒在受伤的宝可梦身上，无论再重的伤都能瞬间愈合。
species.fl_en: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

species.fl: 生命寄宿在燃烧的木炭上，变成了宝可梦。即使面对强敌，也会以燃烧的斗志来迎战。
species.fl_en: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

species.fl: 借助立下诸多功勋的战士所穿的铠甲进化而来的样子。是忠心耿耿的宝可梦。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

species.fl: 双臂的火焰之剑是靠着得志前就亡命的剑士的怨念而燃烧。
species.fl_en: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

species.fl: 通过摇晃尾巴来发电。若感知到有危险，会闪烁头部来通知伙伴。
species.fl_en: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

species.fl: 只要伸缩胖嘟嘟的身体，就能让肚子上的发电脐产生大量的电气。
species.fl_en: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

species.fl: 当翅膀的骨头受到风吹时，就能制造电力。会冲进海里让猎物触电后将其捕获。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

species.fl: 通过膨胀喉囊来增强电力。乘着风可以在１天内就飞上７００公里。
species.fl_en: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

species.fl: 为了不被对手看扁而总是皱着一张脸，却反而会让哭泣的孩子破涕为笑。
species.fl_en: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

species.fl: 大大的喉囊里可以储存能量。会一口气释放能量将敌人轰飞。
species.fl_en: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

species.fl: 虽然性格温和，但一旦被谁激怒，就会用渗入了毒的锋利门牙咬住对方，使其全身麻痹。
species.fl_en: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

species.fl: 它会把随着自己所吃食物而变色的毒唾液涂在指头上，然后在森林的树木上画图案。
species.fl_en: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

species.fl: 无法升天的灵魂在风的吹拂下被卷进枯草里，变成了宝可梦。
species.fl_en: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

species.fl: 张开头部的枝条来吞食猎物。在尽情吸食精气之后，就会把猎物吐出来扔掉。
species.fl_en: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

species.fl: 栖息在潮湿的森林里。它身上脱落的薄片富有嚼劲，非常美味。
species.fl_en: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

species.fl: 会在森林深处建造集体生活用的聚落。非常厌恶有外来者靠近。
species.fl_en: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

species.fl: 会倒挂在悬崖上等待猎物。但那会让它的血液倒流，因此等不了太长的时间。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

species.fl: 沐浴在太阳下越久，体内的辣味成分就会变得越多，招式也会变得越来越辣。
species.fl_en: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

species.fl: 把辣味成分转换成火之能量，然后从红色的头朝四周发射出辣到爆炸的火焰。
species.fl_en: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

species.fl: 将超能力混进泥土和沙子里制作泥球。泥球比自己的命还重要。
species.fl_en: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

species.fl: 支撑着球的身体几乎不动，因此人们认为它的本体其实是在球里面。
species.fl_en: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

species.fl: 由腹部的褶边放射出的精神力量能让它浮在脚尖距离地面仅有１厘米的空中。
species.fl_en: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

species.fl: 大大的眼睛会放出精神力量使对手无法动弹。与外表不同，性格很凶暴。
species.fl_en: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

species.fl: 挥动手工制造的锤子来保护自己，但却经常被会吃金属的宝可梦抢走锤子。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

species.fl: 为了制造又大又坚固的锤子，会去袭击劈斩司令的群体然后收集金属。
species.fl_en: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

species.fl: 智力高超，性格豪迈。会用锤子打飞岩石来攻击飞在空中的钢铠鸦。
species.fl_en: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

species.fl: 就算身处２０米之外，它也能嗅出轻身鳕散发出的气味，然后躲进沙子里藏身。
species.fl_en: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

species.fl: 不同于外表，它性格很粗暴。会用长长的身体勒住猎物，然后将其拖进自己的巢穴里。
species.fl_en: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

species.fl: 用胸部的绒毛和脱落的羽毛做成袋子，然后把东西放进去，并从高处往下丢着玩耍。
species.fl_en: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

species.fl: 喜欢用尾鳍的水环和伙伴一起玩耍。会通过超音波来感知生物的心情。
species.fl_en: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

species.fl: 只要听见伙伴求助的声音，它就会改变自己的样子。那瞬间绝不会让谁看见。（平凡形态）太古基因觉醒之后的样子。力气之大，用单边的鳍就能轻松举起游轮。（全能形态）
species.fl_en: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

species.fl: 据说是神秘的毒宝可梦钻进了放置于废弃工厂的引擎里，从而诞生了它。
species.fl_en: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

species.fl: 在增加到８个之多的汽缸里引爆混有毒素和岩石成分的气体来制造能量。
species.fl_en: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

species.fl: 似乎自古以来就会让人类坐在背上。１万年前的壁画里描绘着那样的情景。
species.fl_en: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

species.fl: 遭到敌人攻击时，会把体毛当做拳头使用，朝着敌人大秀拳头风暴。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

species.fl: 从洞窟的壁上吸取营养。包覆在身上的花瓣是用毒所凝聚的结晶做成的。
species.fl_en: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

species.fl: 只要感应到危险，就会张开结晶的花瓣，从圆锥形的身体发射光束。
species.fl_en: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

species.fl: 据说它是由还未接触人类就去世的流浪犬宝可梦转生而来的。
species.fl_en: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

species.fl: 平时都在墓地里睡觉。在为数众多的犬宝可梦中，它是对主人最为忠诚的。
species.fl_en: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

species.fl: 为了避免积蓄在肚子里的能量流出，它似乎会把自己的脖子系在颈根部上。
species.fl_en: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

species.fl: 自远古时代由大海上岸后，就开始在陆地上生活。似乎与吼吼鲸是相近的物种。
species.fl_en: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

species.fl: 会在冰雪地带回游。以强韧的肌肉和厚实的皮下脂肪来保护身体。
species.fl_en: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

species.fl: 舍弃不必要的肉，能让心灵得以磨砺，精神力量得以提升。赘肉口味清淡，却十分美味。
species.fl_en: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

species.fl: 虽然是个大胃王，却不怎么擅长捕食。会和米立龙联手捕捉猎物。
species.fl_en: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

species.fl: 小型的龙宝可梦。会住在吃吼霸嘴里，保护自己免于外敌袭击。（上弓姿势）身体的颜色和花纹会有差异，似乎是为了便于引诱猎物，而配合其喜好产生的变化。（下垂姿势）鸟宝可梦是它主要的猎物。对自己的弱小心知肚明，因此会和伙伴结伴狩猎。（平挺姿势）
species.fl_en: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

species.fl: 当怒气突破临界点时，它获得了能够摆脱肉体束缚的力量。
species.fl_en: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

species.fl: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会从躯体伸出粗粗的刺来反击。此招式很危险，需有切断身体的觉悟。
species.fl_en: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

species.fl: 通过同步头部和尾巴的脑波，来让自己的超能力提升到了麒麟奇的１０倍之高。
species.fl_en: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

species.fl: 会用坚硬的尾巴来挖穿地下深处的岩盘来筑巢。巢穴长达１０公里。（二节形态）性情温驯，会让误闯进巢穴的宝可梦骑到自己的背上，并将其送到入口。（三节形态）
species.fl_en: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

species.fl: 在气势磅礴的军团中，只有站上顶点的那只劈斩司令才能进化成仆刀将军。
species.fl_en: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

species.fl: 近年有人目击到它。雄伟牙这个名字来自于某本书里记载的生物。
species.fl_en: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

species.fl: 过去只有１次目击纪录。这只宝可梦与古老的探险记所记载的神秘生物长得很像。
species.fl_en: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

species.fl: 某本书中记载的一种叫做猛恶菇的生物有可能就是这只宝可梦。
species.fl_en: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

species.fl: 这只宝可梦与某本书中出现的一种叫振翼发的生物有着相似的特征。
species.fl_en: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

species.fl: 这只神秘的宝可梦与古老的书中介绍的名为爬地翅的生物有相似点。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

species.fl: 没有捕获记录。资料不足。其特征与某本探险记中所记载的生物一致。
species.fl_en: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

species.fl: 它与超自然杂志中所介绍的外星人送来的科学兵器十分相似。
species.fl_en: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

species.fl: 它的外形就像是超自然杂志所报道的诞生于太古文明的机器人。
species.fl_en: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

species.fl: 与超自然杂志曾独家报道过的某运动员被改造成机械生化人的样子很相似。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

species.fl: 它与超自然杂志曾报道过的宝可梦很相似。报道中的宝可梦是爱上机器人的三首恶龙所生的孩子。
species.fl_en: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

species.fl: 与超自然杂志中所介绍的监视人类的ＵＦＯ这种未知物体很相似。
species.fl_en: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

species.fl: 它与可疑杂志所报道的１０亿年后的班基拉斯有部分特征相似。
species.fl_en: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

species.fl: 会用背鳍来吸收热量，并将其转换成冰之能量。温度越高，积累的能量就越多。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

species.fl: 会冻结周围的空气，以冰之面罩来保护脸部，并将背鳍变为冰剑。
species.fl_en: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

species.fl: 从嘴里喷射极低温的冷气。即使是灼热的熔岩，也能使其在一瞬间变成冰块。
species.fl_en: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

species.fl: 大约１５００年前在宝箱里出生。若有坏蛋打算偷走宝藏，就会被它吸走精气。（宝箱形态）从渗入硬币里的热情中诞生。似乎会为了回到原本的宝箱里而在四处徘徊。（徒步形态）
species.fl_en: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

species.fl: 据说它的身体是由１０００枚硬币组成的。喜欢与人亲近，不管与谁都能立刻处好关系。
species.fl_en: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

species.fl: 暂无中文图鉴描述。
species.fl_en: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
